async function nativeBookmark(config) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/${config.account}/d1/database/${config.database}/time_travel/bookmark`, { method: "GET", headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${config.token}`, Accept: "application/json" }, redirect: "error", signal: AbortSignal.timeout(1e4) });

    const reader = response.body.getReader(), chunks = [];
    let length = 0;
    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      length += value.byteLength;
      if (length > 16384) {
        await reader.cancel();
        throw new Error("provider response size");
      }
      chunks.push(value);
    }
    const bytes2 = new Uint8Array(length);
    let offset = 0;
    for (const chunk of chunks) {
      bytes2.set(chunk, offset);
      offset += chunk.byteLength;

  }

async function beginRosterCutoverFreeze(env, { requestId, now = Date.now() } = {}) {

function singapore(now) {
  const sg = new Date(now + 8 * 36e5);
  return { date: sg.toISOString().slice(0, 10), minute: sg.getUTCHours() * 60 + sg.getUTCMinutes() };
}
function quietExpiry(now = Date.now()) {
  const { date, minute } = singapore(now);
  return minute < MORNING_END_MINUTE ? Date.parse(date + "T07:15:00+08:00") : now + DAYTIME_MS;
}

          await Store.open(db, "roster").ensure();
          await Store.open(db, "roster-register").ensure();
          if (!transportInstalled.has(db) && await connection2(db).prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='gsis_absence_transport'").first()) {
            const bump = "UPDATE gsis_roster_mirror_control SET transport_revision=transport_revision+1,updated_at=CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 WHERE id=1; INSERT OR IGNORE INTO gsis_roster_mirror_outbox(scope,revision,created_at) SELECT 'roster-transport',transport_revision,updated_at FROM gsis_roster_mirror_control WHERE id=1;";
            const active = "EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_edge_heads WHERE scope='roster' AND mode IN ('active','paused')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_roster_mirror_control WHERE id=1 AND phase='released')";
            const statements = [];
            for (const event of ["INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE"]) statements.push(db.prepare(`CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS gsis_roster_mirror_transport_${event.toLowerCase()} AFTER ${event} ON gsis_absence_transport WHEN ${active} BEGIN ${bump} END`));
            for (const event of ["INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE"]) statements.push(db.prepare(`CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS gsis_roster_mirror_transport_guard_${event.toLowerCase()} BEFORE ${event} ON gsis_absence_transport WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_roster_mirror_control WHERE id=1 AND phase IN (${event === "INSERT" ? "'quiescing'," : ""}'paused')) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'ROSTER_MIRROR_WRITES_PAUSED'); END`));
            checked5(await db.batch(statements));
            transportInstalled.add(db);
          }
        }

        function generation(row) {
          if (!row) return null;
          return { id: row.id, epoch: row.epoch, revisions: { roster: row.roster_revision, register: row.register_revision }, transportRevision: row.transport_revision, recordCount: row.record_count, receiptCount: row.receipt_count, transportCount: row.transport_count, totalCount: row.record_count + row.receipt_count + row.transport_count, createdAt: row.created_at, state: row.state, cursor: row.cursor, initialDigest: row.initial_digest, snapshotDigest: row.snapshot_digest, manifestDigest: row.manifest_digest, leaseToken: row.lease_token, leaseUntil: row.lease_until, mirroredAt: row.mirrored_at, proof: JSON.parse(row.proof_json || "{}") };
        }
        __name(generation, "generation");
        function publicGeneration(value) {
          if (!value) return null;
          const { leaseToken, leaseUntil, ...safe2 } = value;
          return safe2;
        }

        async function state(db) {
          const c = connection2(db), rs = checked5(await c.batch([c.prepare(`SELECT * FROM gsis_edge_heads WHERE scope IN ${SCOPES} ORDER BY scope`), c.prepare("SELECT * FROM gsis_roster_mirror_control WHERE id=1")]));
          const heads = rs[0].results, control = rs[1].results[0], roster = heads.find((h) => h.scope === "roster"), register = heads.find((h) => h.scope === "roster-register");
          return { control, heads, roster, register, revisions: { roster: roster?.revision || 0, register: register?.revision || 0 }, enabled: heads.length === 2 && heads.every((h) => ["active", "paused"].includes(h.mode)) && control.phase !== "released" };
        }
        __name(state, "state");
        async function status(db, now = Date.now()) {
          await ensure7(db);
          const s = await state(db), c = connection2(db), rs = checked5(await c.batch([c.prepare("SELECT * FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE state='mirrored' ORDER BY mirrored_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1"), c.prepare("SELECT * FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE state='captured' LIMIT 1"), c.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) count,MIN(created_at) oldest FROM gsis_roster_mirror_outbox WHERE generation_id IS NULL")])), pending = rs[2].results[0];
          const latest = generation(rs[0].results[0]), proof = latest && latest.epoch === s.control.epoch && latest.revisions.roster === s.revisions.roster && latest.revisions.register === s.revisions.register && latest.transportRevision === s.control.transport_revision ? latest.proof : null;
          const pendingCount = s.enabled && !proof ? Math.max(1, pending.count) : 0, oldest = pending.oldest || Math.min(...s.heads.map((h) => h.updated_at || now));
          return { proof, lastVerified: proof, enabled: s.enabled, epoch: s.control.epoch, phase: s.control.phase, releaseRequestId: s.control.release_request, revisions: s.revisions, transportRevision: s.control.transport_revision, latest: publicGeneration(generation(rs[0].results[0])), pending: publicGeneration(generation(rs[1].results[0])), pendingCount, lagMs: pendingCount ? Math.max(1, now - oldest) : 0 };
        }
        __name(status, "status");
        function seed(value) {
          return JSON.stringify({ schema: "gsis-roster-mirror-v1", id: value.id, epoch: value.epoch, revisions: value.revisions, transportRevision: value.transportRevision, recordCount: value.recordCount, receiptCount: value.receiptCount, transportCount: value.transportCount });
        }
        __name(seed, "seed");
        async function capture(db, options = {}) {
          await ensure7(db);
          const now = options.now ?? Date.now(), leaseMs = Math.min(6e5, Math.max(1e3, options.leaseMs ?? 42e4)), c = connection2(db);
          for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
            const s = await state(db);
            if (!s.enabled) return { enabled: false, phase: s.control.phase };
            const existing = await c.prepare("SELECT * FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE state='captured' LIMIT 1").first();
            if (existing) {
              const token2 = options.leaseToken === existing.lease_token && existing.lease_until > now ? existing.lease_token : crypto.randomUUID();
              const rs2 = checked5(await c.batch([c.prepare("UPDATE gsis_roster_mirror_generations SET lease_token=?,lease_until=? WHERE id=? AND state='captured' AND epoch=? AND (lease_until<=? OR lease_token=?)").bind(token2, now + leaseMs, existing.id, s.control.epoch, now, options.leaseToken || ""), c.prepare("SELECT * FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE id=?").bind(existing.id)]));
              const row2 = rs2[1].results[0];
              return row2.lease_token === token2 ? { enabled: true, ...generation(row2) } : { enabled: true, busy: true, id: row2.id, leaseUntil: row2.lease_until };
            }
            const mirrored = await c.prepare("SELECT * FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE state='mirrored' AND epoch=? AND roster_revision=? AND register_revision=? AND transport_revision=? ORDER BY mirrored_at DESC LIMIT 1").bind(s.control.epoch, s.revisions.roster, s.revisions.register, s.control.transport_revision).first();
            if (mirrored) return { enabled: true, skipped: true, reason: "caught-up", ...generation(mirrored) };
            const hasTransport = !!await c.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='gsis_absence_transport'").first();
            const count = await c.prepare(`SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gsis_edge_records WHERE scope IN ${SCOPES}) records,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gsis_edge_receipts WHERE scope IN ${SCOPES}) receipts,${hasTransport ? "(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gsis_absence_transport)" : "0"} transport`).first();
            const id3 = crypto.randomUUID(), token = crypto.randomUUID(), meta = { id: id3, epoch: s.control.epoch, revisions: s.revisions, transportRevision: s.control.transport_revision, recordCount: count.records, receiptCount: count.receipts, transportCount: count.transport }, initial = await hash(seed(meta));
            const live = `EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_roster_mirror_control WHERE id=1 AND epoch=? AND phase IN ('normal','quiescing','paused') AND transport_revision=?) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_edge_heads WHERE scope='roster' AND revision=? AND mode IN ('active','paused')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_edge_heads WHERE scope='roster-register' AND revision=? AND mode IN ('active','paused'))`;
            const statements = [
              c.prepare(`INSERT INTO gsis_roster_mirror_generations(id,epoch,roster_revision,register_revision,transport_revision,record_count,receipt_count,transport_count,created_at,initial_digest,snapshot_digest,lease_token,lease_until) SELECT ?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,? WHERE ${live} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE state='captured')`).bind(id3, meta.epoch, meta.revisions.roster, meta.revisions.register, meta.transportRevision, count.records, count.receipts, count.transport, now, initial, initial, token, now + leaseMs, s.control.epoch, s.control.transport_revision, s.revisions.roster, s.revisions.register),
              c.prepare(`INSERT INTO gsis_roster_mirror_items(generation_id,seq,kind,scope,payload) SELECT ?,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY scope,collection,position,record_id),'record',scope,json_object('scope',scope,'collection',collection,'record_id',record_id,'position',position,'record_date',record_date,'value_json',value_json,'revision',revision) FROM gsis_edge_records WHERE scope IN ${SCOPES} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE id=?)`).bind(id3, id3),
              c.prepare(`INSERT INTO gsis_roster_mirror_items(generation_id,seq,kind,scope,payload) SELECT ?,?+ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY scope,actor,request_id),'receipt',scope,json_object('scope',scope,'actor',actor,'request_id',request_id,'digest',digest,'revision',revision,'result_json',result_json,'created_at',created_at) FROM gsis_edge_receipts WHERE scope IN ${SCOPES} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE id=?)`).bind(id3, count.records, id3)
            ];
            if (hasTransport) {
              const columns = (await c.prepare("PRAGMA table_info(gsis_absence_transport)").all()).results.map((x) => x.name);
              const json2 = columns.flatMap((name) => ["'" + name.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'", '"' + name.replaceAll('"', '""') + '"']).join(",");
              statements.push(c.prepare(`INSERT INTO gsis_roster_mirror_items(generation_id,seq,kind,scope,payload) SELECT ?,?+ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY namespace,actor,request_id),'transport','roster',json_object(${json2}) FROM gsis_absence_transport WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE id=?)`).bind(id3, count.records + count.receipts, id3));
            }
            statements.push(c.prepare("SELECT * FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE id=?").bind(id3));
            const rs = checked5(await c.batch(statements)), row = rs.at(-1).results[0];
            if (row) return { enabled: true, ...generation(row) };
          }
          fail14("ROSTER_MIRROR_BUSY", "Roster changed while the backup was being captured. Retry.", 503);
        }

        function lease(g, token, now = Date.now()) {
          if (!g || g.state !== "captured" || !token || g.leaseToken !== token || g.leaseUntil <= now) fail14("ROSTER_MIRROR_LEASE", "This backup step no longer owns its generation.");
        }
        __name(lease, "lease");
        async function page(db, id3, options = {}) {
          await ensure7(db);
          const g = await readGeneration(db, id3);
          lease(g, options.leaseToken, options.now ?? Date.now());
          const cursor = options.cursor ?? g.cursor;
          if (!Number.isSafeInteger(cursor) || cursor !== g.cursor) fail14("ROSTER_MIRROR_CURSOR", "Resume from the accepted backup cursor.");
          const limit = Math.min(1e3, Math.max(1, options.limit ?? 100)), maxBytes = Math.min(MAX_PAGE_BYTES, Math.max(1e3, options.maxBytes ?? 5e5)), result = await connection2(db).prepare("WITH candidates AS (SELECT seq,kind,scope,payload FROM gsis_roster_mirror_items WHERE generation_id=? AND seq>? ORDER BY seq LIMIT ?), sized AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY seq) n,SUM(LENGTH(CAST(payload AS BLOB))+256) OVER(ORDER BY seq) total_bytes FROM candidates) SELECT seq,kind,scope,payload FROM sized WHERE total_bytes<=? OR n=1 ORDER BY seq").bind(id3, cursor, limit, maxBytes).all();
          checked5([result]);
          const items = [];
          let size = 2, chain = g.snapshotDigest;
          for (const row of result.results) {
            const item = { seq: row.seq, kind: row.kind, scope: row.scope, payload: JSON.parse(row.payload) }, json2 = JSON.stringify(item), length = bytes2(json2) + 1;
            if (length > MAX_PAGE_BYTES) fail14("ROSTER_MIRROR_ITEM_SIZE", "A backup record exceeds the bounded transfer size.", 413);
            if (items.length && size + length > maxBytes) break;
            items.push(item);
            size += length;
            chain = await hash(chain + "\n" + json2);
          }
          const next = items.at(-1)?.seq ?? cursor;
          if (next < g.totalCount && !items.length) fail14("ROSTER_MIRROR_INCOMPLETE", "The frozen backup is missing records.", 503);
          return { id: id3, generationId: id3, epoch: g.epoch, cursor, next, done: next === g.totalCount, items, digest: await hash(JSON.stringify(items)), snapshotDigest: chain };
        }
        __name(page, "page");
        async function advance(db, id3, input) {
          await ensure7(db);
          lease(await readGeneration(db, id3), input.leaseToken);
          const accepted = await connection2(db).prepare("SELECT * FROM gsis_roster_mirror_pages WHERE generation_id=? AND cursor=?").bind(id3, input.cursor).first();
          if (accepted) {
            if (accepted.next_cursor !== input.next || accepted.digest !== input.digest) fail14("ROSTER_MIRROR_PAGE", "A different page already owns this cursor.");
            return readGeneration(db, id3);
          }
          const p = await page(db, id3, { cursor: input.cursor, leaseToken: input.leaseToken, limit: 1e3, maxBytes: MAX_PAGE_BYTES });
          const items = p.items.filter((item) => item.seq <= input.next);
          if (!items.length || items.at(-1).seq !== input.next || await hash(JSON.stringify(items)) !== input.digest) fail14("ROSTER_MIRROR_PAGE", "The backup page acknowledgement does not match.");
          const proof = input.proof;
          if (!proof || proof.generationId !== id3 || proof.cursor !== input.cursor || proof.next !== input.next || proof.digest !== input.digest) fail14("ROSTER_MIRROR_PAGE", "Google did not acknowledge this backup page.");
          const g = await readGeneration(db, id3);
          let chain = g.snapshotDigest;
          for (const item of items) chain = await hash(chain + "\n" + JSON.stringify(item));
          const now = Date.now();
          const rs = checked5(await connection2(db).batch([connection2(db).prepare("UPDATE gsis_roster_mirror_generations SET cursor=?,snapshot_digest=?,lease_until=? WHERE id=? AND state='captured' AND cursor=? AND lease_token=? AND lease_until>? AND epoch=(SELECT epoch FROM gsis_roster_mirror_control WHERE id=1)").bind(input.next, chain, now + 42e4, id3, input.cursor, input.leaseToken, now), connection2(db).prepare("INSERT INTO gsis_roster_mirror_pages(generation_id,cursor,next_cursor,digest,snapshot_digest,proof_json) SELECT ?,?,?,?,?,? WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE id=? AND cursor=? AND lease_token=?) ON CONFLICT(generation_id,cursor) DO NOTHING").bind(id3, input.cursor, input.next, input.digest, chain, JSON.stringify(proof), id3, input.next, input.leaseToken), connection2(db).prepare("SELECT * FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE id=?").bind(id3)]));
          if (!rs[0].meta?.changes) fail14("ROSTER_MIRROR_LEASE", "A newer backup step superseded this acknowledgement.");
          return generation(rs.at(-1).results[0]);
        }

        async function cleanup(db, limit = 1e3) {
          await ensure7(db);
          if (!Number.isSafeInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 1e3) fail14("ROSTER_MIRROR_LIMIT", "Choose a cleanup limit from1 to1000.", 400);
          const eligible = "SELECT id FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE (state='mirrored' AND id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE state='mirrored' ORDER BY mirrored_at DESC,rowid DESC LIMIT 2)) OR (state='superseded' AND rowid<(SELECT MAX(rowid) FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE state='mirrored'))";
          const c = connection2(db), rows2 = checked5(await c.batch([c.prepare("DELETE FROM gsis_roster_mirror_items WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM gsis_roster_mirror_items WHERE generation_id IN (" + eligible + ") ORDER BY rowid LIMIT ?)").bind(limit), c.prepare("DELETE FROM gsis_roster_mirror_pages WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM gsis_roster_mirror_pages WHERE generation_id IN (" + eligible + ") ORDER BY rowid LIMIT MAX(0,?-changes()))").bind(limit)]));
          return { itemsRemoved: rows2[0].meta?.changes || 0, pageReceiptsRemoved: rows2[1].meta?.changes || 0 };
        }
        __name(cleanup, "cleanup");
        async function acknowledge(db, id3, input) {
          await ensure7(db);
          const g = await readGeneration(db, id3), s = await state(db);
          if (g?.state === "mirrored" && g.manifestDigest === input.manifestDigest && g.snapshotDigest === input.snapshotDigest) return g;
          lease(g, input.leaseToken);
          if (g.cursor !== g.totalCount || g.epoch !== s.control.epoch || input.verified !== true || input.generationId !== id3 || input.epoch !== g.epoch || input.revisions?.roster !== g.revisions.roster || input.revisions?.register !== g.revisions.register || input.transportRevision !== g.transportRevision || input.snapshotDigest !== g.snapshotDigest || !validHash(input.manifestDigest)) fail14("ROSTER_MIRROR_PROOF", "The complete Google backup proof does not match this generation.");
          const storedProof = { verified: true, generationId: id3, epoch: g.epoch, revisions: g.revisions, transportRevision: g.transportRevision, snapshotDigest: g.snapshotDigest, manifestDigest: input.manifestDigest, ...input.manifestFileId ? { manifestFileId: input.manifestFileId } : {}, ...Number.isSafeInteger(input.largestPart) ? { largestPart: input.largestPart } : {} };
          const c = connection2(db), now = Date.now(), rs = checked5(await c.batch([c.prepare("UPDATE gsis_roster_mirror_generations SET state='mirrored',manifest_digest=?,proof_json=?,mirrored_at=?,lease_token='',lease_until=0 WHERE id=? AND state='captured' AND cursor=record_count+receipt_count+transport_count AND lease_token=? AND lease_until>? AND epoch=(SELECT epoch FROM gsis_roster_mirror_control WHERE id=1)").bind(input.manifestDigest, JSON.stringify(storedProof), now, id3, input.leaseToken, now), c.prepare("UPDATE gsis_roster_mirror_outbox SET generation_id=? WHERE generation_id IS NULL AND ((scope='roster' AND revision<=?) OR (scope='roster-register' AND revision<=?) OR (scope='roster-transport' AND revision<=?)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE id=? AND state='mirrored')").bind(id3, g.revisions.roster, g.revisions.register, g.transportRevision, id3), c.prepare("SELECT * FROM gsis_roster_mirror_generations WHERE id=?").bind(id3)]));
          if (rs.at(-1).results[0]?.state !== "mirrored") fail14("ROSTER_MIRROR_LEASE", "The backup proof was superseded.");
          const saved = generation(rs.at(-1).results[0]);
          try {
            saved.cleanup = await cleanup(db);
          } catch {
            saved.cleanupPending = true;
          }
          return saved;
        }

        async function beginRelease(db, requestId) {
          await ensure7(db);
          request(requestId);
          const c = connection2(db), s = await state(db);
          if (s.control.release_request === requestId && s.control.phase !== "normal") return status(db);
          if (s.control.phase !== "normal" || !s.enabled) fail14("ROSTER_RELEASE_STATE", "Release requires both active D1 scopes and no other release.");
          const rs = checked5(await c.batch([c.prepare("UPDATE gsis_roster_mirror_control SET phase='quiescing',epoch=epoch+1,release_request=?,updated_at=?           if (!rs[0].meta?.changes) fail14("ROSTER_RELEASE_STATE", "Another release started.");
          return status(db);
        }

        async function cancelRelease(db, requestId) {
          await ensure7(db);
          request(requestId);
          const c = connection2(db), s = await state(db);
          if (s.control.phase === "normal") return { ...await status(db), cancelled: true };
          if (s.control.phase !== "quiescing" || s.control.release_request !== requestId) fail14("ROSTER_RELEASE_STATE", "Only an unsealed release can be cancelled.");
          const rs = checked5(await c.batch([c.prepare("UPDATE gsis_roster_mirror_control SET phase='normal',epoch=epoch+1,release_request='',updated_at=? WHERE id=1 AND phase='quiescing' AND release_request=?").bind(Date.now(), requestId), c.prepare("UPDATE gsis_roster_mirror_generations SET state='superseded',lease_token='',lease_until=0 WHERE state='captured' AND epoch<(SELECT epoch FROM gsis_roster_mirror_control WHERE id=1)")]));
          if (!rs[0].meta?.changes) fail14("ROSTER_RELEASE_STATE", "The release was sealed before cancellation.");
          return { ...await status(db), cancelled: true };
        }

        const inFlightSQL = "SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM gsis_edge_records WHERE scope='roster' AND record_id<>'$' AND ((collection IN ('outbox','inboxMessages','inboxAlerts','peerMail','dailyEmploymentMail') AND json_extract(value_json,'$.status') IN ('claimed','sending')) OR (collection IN ('notificationTransport','edgeAllocatorRuns') AND (json_extract(value_json,'$.state') IN ('running','committing') OR json_extract(value_json,'$.status') IN ('claimed','sending'))))";
        async function sealRelease(db, requestId) {
          await ensure7(db);
          request(requestId);
          const c = connection2(db), s = await state(db);
          if (s.control.release_request !== requestId) fail14("ROSTER_RELEASE_STATE", "The release identity changed.");
          if (["paused", "released"].includes(s.control.phase)) return status(db);
          if (s.control.phase !== "quiescing") fail14("ROSTER_RELEASE_STATE", "Quiesce before pausing D1 writes.");
          const transport = !!await c.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='gsis_absence_transport'").first(), guard = `(SELECT n FROM (${inFlightSQL}))=0${transport ? " AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_absence_transport WHERE state='claimed')" : ""}`;
          const rs = checked5(await c.batch([c.prepare(`UPDATE gsis_roster_mirror_control SET phase='paused',updated_at=? WHERE id=1 AND release_request=? AND phase='quiescing' AND ${guard}`).bind(Date.now(), requestId), c.prepare(`UPDATE gsis_edge_heads SET mode='paused',revision=revision+1,updated_at=? WHERE scope IN ${SCOPES} AND mode='active' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_roster_mirror_control WHERE id=1 AND phase='paused' AND release_request=?)`).bind(Date.now(), requestId)]));
          if (!rs[0].meta?.changes) fail14("ROSTER_RELEASE_INFLIGHT", "Wait for in-flight operations to settle before release.");
          return status(db);
        }
        __name(sealRelease, "sealRelease");
        async function finishRelease(db, requestId, proof) {
          await ensure7(db);
          request(requestId);
          const c = connection2(db), s = await state(db);
          if (s.control.release_request === requestId && s.control.phase === "released") return status(db);
          const g = await readGeneration(db, proof?.generationId);
          if (s.control.phase !== "paused" || s.control.release_request !== requestId || !g || g.state !== "mirrored" || g.epoch !== s.control.epoch || g.revisions.roster !== s.revisions.roster || g.revisions.register !== s.revisions.register || g.transportRevision !== s.control.transport_revision || g.manifestDigest !== proof.manifestDigest) fail14("ROSTER_RELEASE_LAG", "The final Google backup has not caught up with paused D1.");
          const result = await c.prepare("UPDATE gsis_roster_mirror_control SET phase='released',updated_at=? WHERE id=1 AND phase='paused' AND release_request=? AND epoch=? AND transport_revision=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_edge_heads WHERE scope='roster' AND mode='paused' AND revision=?) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_edge_heads WHERE scope='roster-register' AND mode='paused' AND revision=?)").bind(Date.now(), requestId, g.epoch, g.transportRevision, g.revisions.roster, g.revisions.register).run();
          checked5([result]);
          if (!result.meta?.changes) fail14("ROSTER_RELEASE_LAG", "D1 changed before release could be confirmed.");
          return status(db);
        }

        function resubmissionIntervals(rows2, dd) {
          const values = rows2.flatMap((a) => absenceIntervals(a, dd)).map((r) => ({ startMinutes: r.startMinutes, endMinutes: r.endMinutes })).sort((a, b) => a.startMinutes - b.startMinutes), result = [];

            const last = result.at(-1);

          }
          return result;
        }

        function runAt(set, p, total) {

          let left = p, right = p;

          while (right + 1 < total && set.has(right + 1)) right++;

        }

          for (let p = 0; p < total; p++) {
            run = set.has(p) ? run + 1 : 0;
            longest = Math.max(longest, run);
          }
          return longest;
        }

        function delivery(s, ctx, p) {
          if (!ctx.service) fail14(403, "Signed WhatsApp service required.");
          if (!p.eventId || typeof p.eventId !== "string" || p.eventId.length > 500 || !["sent", "delivered", "read", "failed"].includes(p.state)) fail14(400, "Invalid inbox delivery event.");
          if (s.deliveryEvents.includes(p.eventId)) return {
            recorded: true,
            duplicate: true
          };
          const m = s.messages.find((m2) => m2.direction === "outbound" && (m2.messageId && m2.messageId === p.messageId || p.replyId && m2.id === p.replyId));
          if (!m) return {
            recorded: false
          };
          if (p.recipientId && waId(p.recipientId) !== m.waId) fail14(403, "Reply recipient does not match.");
          if (s.deliveryEvents.length >= 6e4) fail14(507, "Inbox delivery receipts are full. Ask Admin to archive records.");
          const t = findThread(s, m.waId), rank = {
            sent: 1,
            delivered: 2,
            read: 3
          };
          if (p.messageId && !m.messageId) m.messageId = text(p.messageId, 300);
          if (p.state === "failed") {
            if (!["delivered", "read"].includes(m.deliveryStatus)) {
              m.status = "failed";
              m.deliveryStatus = "failed";
              m.error = providerError(p.error) || {
                message: "WhatsApp confirmed that delivery failed."
              };
            }
          } else if (!(p.state === "sent" && m.deliveryStatus === "failed") && (rank[p.state] || 0) > (rank[m.deliveryStatus] || 0)) {
            m.deliveryStatus = p.state;
            m.status = "sent";
            m.error = null;

function gsisApiSecret(env) {
  const value = env?.GSIS_SECRET;
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !/^[!-~]{32,8000}$/.test(value)) {
    throw Object.assign(
      Error("GSIS_SECRET must contain 32 to 8000 printable ASCII characters without spaces."),
      { status: 503, code: "GSIS_SECRET_INVALID" }
    );
  }
  return value;
}
function configuration(env) {
  const url = env.VENUES_APPS_SCRIPT_URL;
  if (!url) return null;
  const secret = gsisApiSecret(env);
  if (!/^https:\/\/script\.google\.com\/macros\/s\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\/exec$/.test(url || "") || typeof secret !== "string" || secret.length < 32) fail2("VENUES_FENCE_SETUP", "Set VENUES_APPS_SCRIPT_URL and GSIS_SECRET before publishing occupancy.");
  if (!env.GSIS_JOBS?.prepare) fail2("VENUES_FENCE_SETUP", "The durable source fence requires GSIS_JOBS.");
  return { url, secret };
}

  }));
  await schemas4.get(db);
}
async function call(config, input) {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({ action: "venuesService", service: "gsis-venues-v1", timestamp: Date.now(), nonce: crypto.randomUUID(), input }), key2 = await crypto.subtle.importKey("raw", encoder.encode(config.secret), { name: "HMAC", hash: "SHA-256" }, false, ["sign"]), signature = [...new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign("HMAC", key2, encoder.encode(payload)))].map((x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
  let result;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(config.url, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ payload, signature }), redirect: "follow", signal: AbortSignal.timeout(25e3) });
    if (!response.ok) throw Error();
    result = await response.json();
  } catch {
    fail2("VENUES_FENCE_UNCERTAIN", "Venues coordination could not be confirmed. Retry this same change.");
  }
  if (result?.ok !== true || !result.data) fail2("VENUES_FENCE_REJECTED", "Venues has not accepted this source change. Review its pending source fence.");

}
async function beginEdgeVenuesChange(env, { source, requestId }) {
  if (!["roster", "deploy"].includes(source) || typeof requestId !== "string" || !requestId || requestId.length > 200) fail2("VENUES_FENCE_INPUT", "A source and stable request ID are required.", 400);
  const config = configuration(env);
  if (!config) return null;

    if (writes[0].meta?.changes !== 1) fail2("VENUES_FENCE_PENDING", "Another occupancy update started first.", 409);
    row = { source, request_id: requestId, token, prior_revision: prior, phase: "prepared" };
  }
  if (["committed", "recovering"].includes(row.phase)) fail2("VENUES_FENCE_RECOVERY", "The previous occupancy save committed. Complete its source fence before retrying.", 409);

  if (ack.status !== "pending" || ack.pendingToken !== row.token || ack.revision !== row.prior_revision) fail2("VENUES_FENCE_UNCERTAIN", "Venues did not confirm the exact source fence.");

}
async function completeEdgeVenuesChange(env, { source, requestId, revision }) {
  const config = configuration(env);
  if (!config) return null;
  if (typeof revision !== "string" || !revision || revision.length > 200) fail2("VENUES_FENCE_INPUT", "A verified committed source revision is required.");

  const ack = await call(config, { operation: "sourceComplete", source, token: row.token, revision });
  if (ack.pendingToken || ack.revision !== revision || !["ready", "stale"].includes(ack.status)) fail2("VENUES_FENCE_UNCERTAIN", "Venues did not confirm the committed occupancy revision.");

}

async function revokeEdgeVenuesChange(env, { source, requestId }) {
  const config = configuration(env);
  if (!config) return null;
  const db = env.GSIS_JOBS;
  await ensure6(db);

  const results = await db.batch([db.prepare("UPDATE gsis_timetable_fences SET phase='recovering',updated_at=? WHERE source=? AND token=?   if (results[0].meta?.changes !== 1) fail2("VENUES_FENCE_RECOVERY", "The source request changed during recovery.", 409);

    if (ack.pendingToken !== row.token || ack.revision !== row.prior_revision) fail2("VENUES_FENCE_UNCERTAIN", "The revoked source has not confirmed its recovery fence.");
  }
  return { source, requestId, token: row.token, revoked: true };

function normaliseLegacy(value) {
  if (value?.schema !== "gsis-deploy-edge-v1" || !value.index || !Array.isArray(value.documents)) fail3(400, "Invalid Deploy export.");
  const state = knownState({ index: clone(value.index), leases: {}, properties: value.properties || {}, receipts: value.receipts || {}, drafts: {}, publications: {}, deltas: {}, jobs: {} });
  state.index.publicationSchema = 1;
  state.index.migrationSourceRevision = value.index.revision;
  state.index.requests = state.index.requests || [];
  for (const item of value.documents) {
    const prefix = (item.published ? item.entry.commit : item.entry.id) + "|", target = state[item.published ? "publications" : "drafts"];
    for (const [key2, val] of Object.entries(item.fields)) target[prefix + key2] = val;
  }
  for (const en of state.index.versions) {
    en.store = "d1";
    delete en.lastDelta;
  }
  if (state.index.published) {
    state.index.published.edgePublished = true;
    state.index.published.store = "d1";
    delete state.index.published.lastDelta;
  }
  state.index.venuePublications = (state.index.venuePublications || []).map((en) => ({ ...en, store: "d1", edgePublished: true, lastDelta: null }));
  return state;
}

async function notifyOutputAlert(db, { kind, now, health, message, enabled: enabled2 }, alert) {

    }
    return;
  }
  if (!await enabled2()) return;
  const day2 = singaporeBackupDate(now), id3 = "drive-" + kind + "-" + day2;

  if (sent?.queued === true) await db.prepare("UPDATE gsis_output_alerts SET queued=1 WHERE kind=? AND day=?").bind(kind, day2).run();
}

function buildContinuityView(state, ctx, dates2) {
  const people = new Map(ctx.people.map((p) => [p.id, p])), name = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((id3) => people.get(id3)?.name || people.get(state.absences.find((a) => a.id === id3)?.staffId)?.name || id3 || "", "name");
  const days = dates2.map((date) => ({
    date,
    stapler: state.staplerPlans.some((p) => p.date === date && (p.confirmed || p.published)),
    absences: state.absences.filter((a) => a.date === date && !a.deletedAt).map((a) => ({ teacher: name(a.staffId), periods: GSISRosterAllocation.absencePeriods(a, ctx.days[date]).map((p) => "P" + p).join(", "), type: "Absent" })),
    assignments: GSISRosterAllocation.effectiveAssignments(state).filter((a) => a.date === date).map((a) => ({ period: "P" + a.period, className: a.className || "", absentTeacher: (a.absentIds || [a.absentId]).map(name).filter(Boolean).join(", "), reliefTeacher: name(a.staffId), status: a.status || "draft" }))
  }));
  const engaged = new Set(state.adhoc.filter((a) => !a.deletedAt && dates2.includes(a.date)).map((a) => a.staffId));
  const fairness = ctx.people.filter((p) => p.active || engaged.has(p.id)).map((p) => {
    const value = GSISRosterAllocation.personalCompletion(state, p.id, ctx.today, ctx.now);
    return { teacher: p.name, quota: value.entitlement ?? "Not available", done: value.historyVerified ? value.completed : "Not verified", percent: value.percentage === null ? "Not available" : Number(value.percentage.toFixed(2)) };

async function encodedFile(bucket2, date, revision, file) {
  const bytes2 = file.bytes instanceof Uint8Array ? file.bytes : new TextEncoder().encode(file.bytes);
  if (!["excel", "log"].includes(file.kind) || bytes2.length > MAX_RAW2) fail8("DAILY_OUTPUT_SIZE", "A daily output exceeds its 16 MiB raw limit.");
  const digest2 = await dailyBytesDigest(bytes2), gzip2 = new Uint8Array(await new Response(new Blob([bytes2]).stream().pipeThrough(new CompressionStream("gzip"))).arrayBuffer());
  if (gzip2.length > MAX_GZIP2) fail8("DAILY_OUTPUT_SIZE", "A daily output exceeds its 8 MiB transfer limit.");
  const key2 = "gsis/roster/daily-outputs/" + date + "/" + revision + "/" + file.kind + "-" + digest2 + ".gz";
  await bucket2.put(key2, gzip2, { httpMetadata: { contentType: "application/gzip" }, customMetadata: { digest: digest2, kind: file.kind, date } });
  return { kind: file.kind, key: key2, digest: digest2, bytesRaw: bytes2.length, bytesCompressed: gzip2.length, records: file.records || 0, done: false };
}
async function readEncoded(bucket2, file) {

  if (!object4) fail8("DAILY_OUTPUT_MISSING", "The retained daily output is missing.");
  const compressed = new Uint8Array(await object4.arrayBuffer());
  if (compressed.length !== file.bytesCompressed || compressed.length > MAX_GZIP2) fail8("DAILY_OUTPUT_INTEGRITY", "The retained daily output size changed.");
  const reader = new Blob([compressed]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("gzip")).getReader(), chunks = [];
  let size = 0;
  try {
    for (; ; ) {
      const r = await reader.read();
      if (r.done) break;
      size += r.value.length;

    }
  } finally {

    });
  }

  let at = 0;
  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    raw2.set(chunk, at);
    at += chunk.length;
  }
  if (size !== file.bytesRaw || await dailyBytesDigest(raw2) !== file.digest) fail8("DAILY_OUTPUT_INTEGRITY", "The retained daily output digest changed.");
  return compressed;
}

function rosterAllocationAuditCapture_(state, accepted) {

      if (accepted.requestId) event.requestId = accepted.requestId;
    }
    if (event.auditExportCaptured) continue;

      event.limitedHistoricalEvidence = true;
    }
    event.auditExportCaptured = true;
    captured.push(event);
    dates2.add(event.date);
  }
  if (state.systemConfig?.verboseLogging !== false) {
    for (const date of accepted?.schoolDates || []) if (!state.allocationAuditExports[date]) dates2.add(date);
  }
  for (const date of dates2) {
    const row = state.allocationAuditExports[date] || (state.allocationAuditExports[date] = { pendingVersion: 0, exportedVersion: 0, exportedRevision: 0, fileId: null });
    row.pendingVersion = (row.pendingVersion || 0) + 1;
    row.pendingRevision = state.revision;
    row.lastEventId = events.filter((e) => e.date === date).at(-1)?.id || null;
    row.updatedAt = accepted?.at || (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString();
    for (const event of captured.filter((event2) => event2.date === date)) event.auditExportVersion = row.pendingVersion;
  }
}

        else detail = "Uncovered. " + clean(lesson.uncoveredReason || "No accepted eligible allocation was found.");
        lines.push(prefix + detail);
        if (chosen?.teachingProfile) {
          lines.push("Captured teaching profile for " + name(lesson.selectedStaffId) + ": levels " + (chosen.teachingProfile.levels || []).map(clean).join(", ") + "; subject families " + (chosen.teachingProfile.subjects || []).map((value) => clean(value).replace(/^family:/, "")).join(", ") + ".");
        }
      }
      for (const period of evidence?.periods || []) {
        lines.push("P" + clean(period.period) + " eligible teachers: " + (period.eligibleStaffIds || []).map(name).join(", ") + ".");
        for (const value of period.comparisons || []) lines.push("P" + clean(period.period) + " comparison for " + name(value.staffId) + ": recommendation rank " + clean(value.rank ?? "not recorded") + "; annual fairness band " + clean(value.fairnessBand ?? "unverified") + "; other eligible periods " + clean(value.alternatives ?? "not recorded") + "; rotation position " + clean(value.rotation ?? "not recorded") + ". This is a period-level comparison, not a proof of the complete-plan choice.");
        for (const exclusion of period.excluded || []) lines.push("P" + clean(period.period) + " excluded: " + (exclusion.staffIds || []).map(name).join(", ") + ". Reason: " + clean(exclusion.reason) + ".");
      }
    }
    if (entry.operation === "notifyDaily") lines.push("This records the request to send WhatsApp; it does not claim delivery or acknowledgement.");
    if (["publish", "publishDaily", "publishStapler"].includes(entry.operation)) lines.push("This records teacher-visible publication; it does not establish actual completion of relief.");
    lines.push("");
  }
  if (!entries.length) lines.push("No allocation activity recorded.");
  return lines.filter((line) => line !== void 0).join("\n") + "\n";
}

async function drainRosterImports(db, advance, { maxSteps = 8, budgetMs = 18e4 } = {}) {

  if (!claimed.meta?.changes) return { pending: 1, readyAt: now + 2e3 };

    if ((await readRosterCutoverFreeze({ GSIS_JOBS: db })).state === "cancelling") throw Object.assign(Error("Import is paused while freeze cancellation is confirmed."), { status: 503, code: "ROSTER_CUTOVER_CANCELLING" });

    if (current?.state !== "running" || current.claim_token !== token) throw Object.assign(Error("The import continuation is no longer owned by this runner."), { status: 409, code: current?.error_code || "ROSTER_IMPORT_STOPPED" });
  }
  __name(guard, "guard");
  let result, steps = 0, state = "waiting", readyAt = 0, errorCode = "";

      await guard();
      const progress = await store.progress();
      if (!progress || progress.requiresRestart) {
        state = "attention";
        break;
      }
      if (progress.imported) {
        state = "complete";
        break;
      }
      const renewed = checked4(await c.prepare(`UPDATE ${TABLE} SET lease_until=?,updated_at=? WHERE session_id=? AND claim_token=?`).bind(Date.now() + LEASE_MS, Date.now(), job.session_id, token).run());

      result = await advance(input, identity2, guard);
      steps++;
      if (result.imported) {
        state = "complete";
        break;
      }
      if (result.requiresRestart) {
        state = "attention";
        break;
      }
      if (result.preparationLeaseUntil > Date.now()) {
        readyAt = ["ROSTER_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT", "ROSTER_GOOGLE_TIMEOUT"].includes(progress.failureReason?.code) ? Math.min(result.preparationLeaseUntil, Date.now() + 5e3) : result.preparationLeaseUntil;
        break;
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    const preparation = await store.preparationStatus();
    readyAt = ["ROSTER_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT", "ROSTER_GOOGLE_TIMEOUT"].includes(error.code) ? Date.now() + 5e3 : Math.max(Date.now() + 6e4, preparation?.busy ? preparation.leaseUntil : 0);
    state = error.status >= 400 && error.status < 500 && ![408, 429].includes(error.status) ? "attention" : "waiting";

  }
  checked4(await c.prepare(`UPDATE ${TABLE} SET state=?,claim_token='',lease_until=0,next_at=?,error_code=?,updated_at=? WHERE session_id=? AND claim_token=?`).bind(state, readyAt, errorCode, Date.now(), job.session_id, token).run());
  return { completed: state === "complete" ? 1 : 0, pending: state === "waiting" ? 1 : 0, needsReview: state === "attention" ? 1 : 0, processed: steps, ...readyAt ? { readyAt } : {}, ...errorCode ? { code: errorCode } : {} };
}

async function readEdgeRosterReferences(env, { allowExpired = false } = {}) {
  const loaded = await open(env, "roster-references"), refs = loaded.state;
  if (!refs?.contacts) fail9(503, "ROSTER_REFERENCES_MISSING", "Refresh the trusted Roster references.");

function inputDates(input, state, today) {
  const values = [input.date || today, ...input.dates || []];
  if (input.from && input.to) {
    let from = GSISRoster2.date(input.from), to = GSISRoster2.date(input.to);
    if (to < from || Date.parse(to) - Date.parse(from) > 365 * 864e5) fail9(400, "ROSTER_DATE_RANGE", "Select no more than one full school year.");
    for (let n = Date.parse(from); n <= Date.parse(to); n += 864e5) values.push(new Date(n).toISOString().slice(0, 10));
  }
  for (const key2 of ["actualDate", "newDate"]) if (input[key2]) values.push(input[key2]);
  for (const id3 of [input.id, input.absenceId, ...input.ids || [], ...input.absenceIds || []]) {
    const row = state.absences?.find((x) => x.id === id3) || state.requests?.find((x) => x.id === id3);
    if (row) values.push(row.date);
  }
  return [...new Set(values.map(GSISRoster2.date))];
}

async function edgeRosterBackend(env, action, input, who, traceId) {
  const started = Date.now();
  try {
    return { result: { ok: true, data: await dispatch(env, action, input, who) }, backendMs: Date.now() - started, upstreamTraceId: traceId };
  } catch (error) {
    return { result: { ok: false, status: error.status || 503, error: error.message, code: error.code || "ROSTER_EDGE_ERROR", ...error.conflicts ? { conflicts: error.conflicts } : {} }, backendMs: Date.now() - started, upstreamTraceId: traceId };
  }
}
async function dispatch(env, action, input, who) {
  if (action === "rosterOperations") return operations(env, input, who);
  const loaded = await loadEdgeRoster(env, { hydrate: false }), ctx = await buildEdgeRosterContext(env, loaded.state, { operation: "currentDuty" }, who), register = await readEdgeRosterRegister(env), index = register.state, date = GSISRoster2.date(input.date || ctx.today), manager = ctx.user.smc || ctx.user.admin, status = registerStatus(index, date, manager);
  if (action === "rosterProfile") {
    const output = { ...status, user: { ...ctx.user, accessVerified: true }, version: "0.9.9", ...GSISRosterOperations.historyCoverage(loaded.state) ? { historyCoverage: GSISRosterOperations.historyCoverage(loaded.state) } : {} };
    if (input.view === "reportForm") output.reportForm = GSISRosterOperations.reportFormView(loaded.state, ctx, input);
    if (input.view === "report") output.reportData = await operations(env, { ...input, operation: "read", view: "report", compact: true }, who);
    if (input.preload === true) Object.assign(output, await modelResponse(env, index.entries.find((entry2) => entry2.id === status.selected?.id), input));
    return output;
  }
  if (action === "rosterRead") {
    const entry2 = input.id && manager ? index.entries.find((entry3) => entry3.id === input.id) : index.entries.find((entry3) => entry3.id === status.selected?.id);
    if (input.id && !manager && input.id !== status.active?.id) fail9(403, "ROSTER_BASELINE_ACCESS", "Only the timetable in force is available.");
    if (input.view === "names") {
      const model = await readEdgeRosterModel(env, entry2);
      return { ...status, modelId: entry2?.id || null, names: model ? GSISRoster2.weeks(model)[0][1].blocks.map((row) => row.name) : [] };
    }
    return { ...status, ...await modelResponse(env, entry2, input) };
  }
  if (!["rosterUpload", "rosterUpdate"].includes(action)) fail9(404, "ROSTER_ACTION", "Unknown Roster action.");
  if (action === "rosterUpload" ? !ctx.user.admin : !manager) fail9(403, "ROSTER_BASELINE_PERMISSION", "Baseline management requires SMC or Admin access.");
  validRequest(input.requestId);
  const digest2 = await GSiSEdgeStore.digest(input), prior = await register.store.receipt(who.email, input.requestId, digest2);
  if (prior) {
    await completeRosterFence(env, input.requestId);
    return { ...prior.result, replayed: true };
  }
  if (input.revision !== index.revision) fail9(409, "ROSTER_REGISTER_CONFLICT", "The timetable register changed. Refresh before saving.");

    }
    if (bytes2.length < 4 || bytes2.length > 8e6 || bytes2[0] !== 80 || bytes2[1] !== 75 || bytes2[2] !== 3 || bytes2[3] !== 4) fail9(400, "ROSTER_WORKBOOK", "Upload a genuine Excel workbook.");

async function operations(env, input, who, runId = null) {
  const p = { ...input, operation: input.operation || "read" };
  delete p._edgeAttendance;
  const op = p.operation;
  if (["autoAllocate", "optimise"].includes(op) && !runId) return allocateWithRun(env, p, who);
  if (op === "timetableBatch") {
    const { edgeTimetableBatch: edgeTimetableBatch2 } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => (init_edge_timetable_cache(), edge_timetable_cache_exports));

  }
  if (op === "nextSchoolDay") {

    for (let n = 1; n <= 62; n++) {

      if (value?.available !== true) return { today, date: null, available: false, message: "The next school day has not been verified." };
      if (value.schoolDay) return { today, date, available: true };
    }
    return { today, date: null, available: false };
  }
  if (op === "contactCreate") return createEdgeContact(env, p, who);
  if (op === "read" && p.view === "intakeReview") return reviewEdgeIntake(env, p, who);
  if (op === "resolveAbsenceIntake" && ["merge", "keep"].includes(p.resolution)) return resolveEdgeIntake(env, p, who);
  if (["retryAbsenceIntake", "resolveAbsenceIntake"].includes(op)) return manageEdgeIntake(env, p, who);
  if (op === "receiptStatus") {
    const command2 = p.command;
    if (!command2) fail9(400, "ROSTER_RECEIPT_COMMAND", "Supply the original save command.");
    const loaded = await loadEdgeRoster(env, { hydrate: false });
    await buildEdgeRosterContext(env, loaded.state, { operation: "receiptStatus" }, who);
    const receipt = await loaded.store.receipt(who.email, command2.requestId, await GSiSEdgeStore.digest(canonicalCommand(command2)));
    if (receipt) return { ...await receiptResult(env, loaded.state, receipt.result), accepted: true, replayed: true, found: true };
    const legacy = loaded.state.receipts?.find((row) => row.id === command2.requestId);
    if (legacy) {
      if (legacy.actor !== who.email || legacy.digest !== legacyCommandDigest(command2)) fail9(409, "ROSTER_LEGACY_RECEIPT_CONFLICT", "This save request already exists with different content.");
      return { ...legacy.result, accepted: true, receiptOnly: true, requestId: command2.requestId, acceptedAt: legacy.at, revision: legacy.revision, found: true, replayed: true };
    }
    const applied = (loaded.state.edgeAbsenceReceipts || []).find((row) => row.id === command2.requestId && row.actor === who.email);
    if (applied) {
      if (await GSiSEdgeStore.digest(canonicalCommand(applied.command)) !== await GSiSEdgeStore.digest(canonicalCommand(command2))) fail9(409, "ROSTER_RECEIPT_CONFLICT", "This report has different original content.");
      return { ...await receiptResult(env, loaded.state, { requestId: command2.requestId }), found: true, replayed: true };
    }
    return { accepted: false, confirmation: "unconfirmed", found: false, requestId: command2.requestId };

  return result;
}
function leaseView(row, user, p, now) {
  const active = !!row?.owner && row.until > now;
  return { fence: row?.fence || 0, active, mine: active && row.owner === user.email && row.staffId === user.staffId && row.session === p.leaseSessionId, ownerName: active ? row.name : "", expiresAt: active ? row.until : null, renewAfterMs: 45e3, canRelease: user.admin === true && active };
}

    if (!GSISRosterOperations.staplerPermission(state, ctx, date)) fail9(403, "STAPLER_PERMISSION", "You cannot edit this suspended timetable.");
    state.edgeStaplerLeases ||= {};
    const row = state.edgeStaplerLeases[date] || { fence: 0 }, active = !!row.owner && row.until > ctx.now, own = row.owner === who.email && row.staffId === ctx.user.staffId && row.session === p.leaseSessionId && row.fence === p.leaseFence;

      const revision = state.staplerPlans.find((r) => r.date === date)?.revision || 0;

      if (active && row.owner === who.email && row.session === p.leaseSessionId && row.acquireBase === p.leaseFence) return { lock: leaseView(row, ctx.user, p, ctx.now), staplerRevision: revision };
      if (row.fence !== p.leaseFence || active) fail9(409, "STAPLER_LEASE_CHANGED", active ? "This plan is being edited by " + row.name + ". Open it read only or try again later." : "The editing lock changed. Reload before editing.");
      saved = { fence: row.fence + 1, acquireBase: row.fence, owner: who.email, staffId: ctx.user.staffId, authority: ctx.user.admin || ctx.user.smc ? "manager" : "sponsored", session: p.leaseSessionId, name: ctx.people.find((person) => person.id === ctx.user.staffId)?.name || who.email, until: ctx.now + 18e4 };
    } else if (p.operation === "renewStaplerLock") {

      saved = { ...row, until: ctx.now + 18e4 };

      saved = { fence: row.fence + 1, releasedFence: row.fence, releasedBy: who.email, releasedAt: ctx.now };
    }
    state.edgeStaplerLeases[date] = saved;

  } });

      if (!request) fail9(403, "PRIVATE_REQUEST_UNAVAILABLE", "This private request is unavailable.");
      if (["approved", "rejected"].includes(request.status)) {
        if (request.status === (p.decision === "approve" ? "approved" : "rejected") && String(request.reason || "") === String(p.reason || "").trim()) return { recorded: true, replayed: true, status: request.status };
        fail9(409, "PEER_RESPONSE_CONFLICT", "A different response has already been recorded.");
      }
      GSISRosterOperations.apply(state, ctx, { operation: "respondMutual", id: cap.requestId, date: cap.date, decision: p.decision, reason: p.reason || "" });
      return { recorded: true, status: request.status };
    }, ...op === "externalAcknowledge" ? { needsContext: false } : {}, command: { ...p, date: cap.date } });
  }
  if (op === "resolveDuplicateIntake") return resolveDuplicateIntake(env);
  if (op === "processEdgePeerProposals") {
    const instructions = await processEdgeInstructionDrafts(env);
    return { ...await processEdgePeerProposals(env), instructions };
  }
  if (op === "prewarmTimetables") {
    const { drainEdgeTimetableJobs: drainEdgeTimetableJobs2 } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => (init_edge_timetable_cache(), edge_timetable_cache_exports));
    return drainEdgeTimetableJobs2(env, { service: true, email: "roster-service" }, { limit: p.limit });
  }
  if (op === "nextAbsenceIntake") return { job: null };
  if (op === "allocationAuditExport") return exportEdgeAudit(env, p);
  if (op === "connectionStatus") {
    const loaded = await loadEdgeRoster(env, { hydrate: false });
    await readEdgeRosterReferences(env);
    return { readOnly: true, backendVersion: "0.9.7", contactsReady: true, authority: "d1", revision: loaded.state.revision };
  }
  if (op === "scheduledRoster") return runScheduledRoster(env, p);
  fail9(403, "ROSTER_EDGE_SERVICE_OPERATION", "This service operation is not available in the D1 authority.");
}
async function processEdgePeerProposals(env) {
  const pending = await pendingServiceRows(env, "edgePeerProposals");
  let applied = 0, needsReview = 0;
  for (const proposal of pending) {
    try {
      await mutateEdgeRoster(env, { actor: proposal.actor, who: proposal.identity, requestId: "peer-" + proposal.id + (proposal.retryCount ? "-" + proposal.retryCount : ""), allowDuringQuiesce: true, command: { operation: "requestMutual", proposalOnly: true, date: proposal.date, dates: Object.values(proposal.command.ownArrangementsByStaffDate || {}).flatMap((dated) => Object.keys(dated)), proposalId: proposal.id }, apply(state, ctx) {
        const row = state.edgePeerProposals.find((row2) => row2.id === proposal.id);
        if (row.status !== "pending") return { replayed: true };
        const ids = [];
        for (const [staffId, dated] of Object.entries(row.command.ownArrangementsByStaffDate || {})) for (const [date, picks] of Object.entries(dated)) {
          const absence = state.absences.find((a) => row.savedIds.includes(a.id) && a.staffId === staffId && a.date === date && !a.deletedAt);
          if (!absence || !absence.reliefRequired) fail9(409, "PEER_ABSENCE_CHANGED", "The absence changed before peer arrangements were recorded.");
          const day2 = ctx.days[date], lessons = GSISRosterOperations.previewAbsence(ctx, absence), requests = picks.map((pick) => {
            const lesson = lessons.find((lesson2) => lesson2.period === pick.period);
            if (!lesson || lesson.lessonKey !== pick.lessonKey || day2.id !== pick.expectedTimetableId || day2.parity !== pick.expectedParity || !Number.isInteger(pick.expectedStaplerRevision)) fail9(409, "PEER_LESSON_CHANGED", "A selected lesson changed. Review your retained colleague choices.");
            if (pick.combination && JSON.stringify(day2.teachers.find((t) => t.staffId === pick.recipientId)?.cells[pick.period]) !== JSON.stringify(pick.expectedRecipientCell)) fail9(409, "PEER_COMBINATION_CHANGED", "The colleague\u2019s lesson changed. Review this combination.");
            return { demandIds: [lesson.id], recipientId: pick.recipientId, combination: pick.combination === true };
          });
          const result = GSISRosterOperations.apply(state, ctx, { operation: "requestMutual", date, absenceId: absence.id, requests, proposalOnly: true });
          ids.push(...result.savedIds);
        }
        Object.assign(row, { status: "applied", appliedAt: ctx.iso, mutualRequestIds: ids });
        return { mutualRequestIds: ids };
      } });
      applied++;
    } catch (error) {
      if ((!error.status || [400, 403, 404, 409, 422].includes(error.status)) && !["EDGE_CONFLICT", "EDGE_REVISION_CONFLICT", "REVISION_CONFLICT", "PREPARED_RETRY", "ROSTER_COMMIT_BUSY"].includes(error.code)) {
        await mutateEdgeRoster(env, { actor: "roster-service", requestId: "peer-review-" + proposal.id + (proposal.retryCount ? "-" + proposal.retryCount : ""), allowDuringQuiesce: true, command: { operation: "peerReview", proposalId: proposal.id }, needsContext: false, apply(state, ctx) {
          const row = state.edgePeerProposals.find((row2) => row2.id === proposal.id);
          if (row?.status === "pending") Object.assign(row, { status: "needsReview", reasonCode: error.code || "PEER_VALIDATION", message: error.status ? error.message : "The absence is saved. The peer proposal needs review before sending.", reviewAt: ctx.iso });
          return { retained: true };
        } });
        needsReview++;
      }
    }
  }
  return { applied, needsReview, pending: pending.length - applied - needsReview };
}
function edgeManualAllocationBusy(run, now) {
  return run?.trigger === "manual" && ["running", "cancelling", "committing", "uncertain"].includes(run.state) && now - Date.parse(run.updatedAt) <= 6e5;
}

async function runScheduledRoster(env, p) {
  const clock2 = edgeRosterClock(), stamp = p.scheduledTime ?? clock2.now;
  if (!Number.isFinite(stamp) || stamp > clock2.now + 6e4 || clock2.now - stamp > 12e4) fail9(400, "ROSTER_STALE_TICK", "Scheduled tick is stale.");
  const slot = GSISRosterAllocation.schedule(stamp), date = slot.date, requestId = "scheduled-" + Math.floor(stamp / 6e4), work = await scheduledRosterWork(env, clock2, stamp, slot);
  if (work.busy) return { code: "SKIPPED_BUSY", skipped: true, allocationSkipped: true };
  if (work.replayed) return { replayed: true };
  if (!work.due) return { idle: true, allocationPaused: !work.enabled };
  const id3 = sha256Hex(requestId), running = slot.optimise && work.enabled;
  try {
    if (running) await mutateEdgeRoster(env, { actor: "roster-service", requestId: "run-" + requestId, command: { operation: "currentDuty", date }, domainChanged: false, apply(state, ctx) {
      state.edgeAllocatorRuns ||= {};
      const prior = state.edgeAllocatorRuns[date];
      if (edgeManualAllocationBusy(prior, ctx.now)) fail9(409, "SKIPPED_BUSY", "Scheduled allocation deferred while an SMC run owns this date.");
      if (prior && prior.id !== id3 && prior.state === "running" && Date.parse(prior.updatedAt) > ctx.now - 6e5) fail9(409, "ALLOCATION_IN_PROGRESS", "Another allocator is already running.");
      state.edgeAllocatorRuns[date] = { id: id3, date, state: "running", authority: "d1", trigger: "scheduled", scheduleKey: slot.key, actor: "roster-service", actorName: "Scheduled allocator", startedAt: ctx.iso, updatedAt: ctx.iso, canCancel: true, log: [{ seq: 1, at: ctx.iso, message: "Preparing current timetable and staffing inputs." }] };
      return { started: true };
    } });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code === "SKIPPED_BUSY") return { code: "SKIPPED_BUSY", skipped: true, allocationSkipped: true };
    throw error;
  }
  try {
    const result = await mutateEdgeRoster(env, { actor: "roster-service", requestId, command: { operation: "scheduledRoster", date, scheduledTime: stamp }, beforeCommit: /* @__PURE__ */ __name((state, ctx, loaded) => JSON.stringify(state.dailyPublicationStates) !== JSON.stringify(loaded.rawState.dailyPublicationStates) ? beginEdgeVenuesChange(env, { source: "roster", requestId }) : null, "beforeCommit"), apply(state, ctx) {
      if (edgeManualAllocationBusy(state.edgeAllocatorRuns?.[date], ctx.now)) fail9(409, "SKIPPED_BUSY", "Scheduled allocation deferred while an SMC run owns this date.");
      const before = state.outbox.length, run = running ? state.edgeAllocatorRuns?.[date] : null;
      ctx.service = true;
      ctx.skipScheduledAllocation = !!run && (run.id !== id3 || run.state === "cancelled");
      reconcileOperationalState(state, ctx);
      const result2 = GSISRosterOperations.scheduledTick(state, ctx, stamp) || {};
      if (run?.id === id3 && run.state === "running") {
        Object.assign(run, { state: "completed", canCancel: false, updatedAt: ctx.iso });
        run.log.push({ seq: run.log.length + 1, at: ctx.iso, message: "Scheduled allocation completed. Saved human decisions were retained." });
        for (const message of GSISRosterOperations.allocationPriorityLog(state, run)) run.log.push({ seq: run.log.length + 1, at: ctx.iso, message });
      }
      return { ...result2, notificationsQueued: state.outbox.length - before, allocatorRun: run || null };
    } });
    await completeRosterFence(env, requestId);
    if (result.published || result.massPublished) await scheduleTimetable(env, { stage: "suspended", dates: [date], revision: result.revision });
    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code === "SKIPPED_BUSY") return { code: "SKIPPED_BUSY", skipped: true, allocationSkipped: true };
    if (running) await recordEdgeAllocationFailure(env, date, id3, "run-failed-" + requestId, error);
    throw error;
  }
}

async function signedBridge(env, input, who, guard) {
  const service2 = !who, secret = service2 ? gsisApiSecret3(env) : gsisApiSecret3(env);
  if (typeof secret !== "string" || secret.length < 32) fail9(503, "ROSTER_BRIDGE_CONFIG", "Configure the signed Roster Google adapter.");
  const endpoint = new URL(env.APPS_SCRIPT_URL || "");
  if (endpoint.protocol !== "https:" || endpoint.hostname !== "script.google.com" || !/^\/macros\/s\/[^/]+\/exec$/.test(endpoint.pathname)) fail9(503, "ROSTER_BRIDGE_CONFIG", "Configure the Roster Apps Script deployment URL.");
  const raw2 = JSON.stringify({ action: service2 ? "rosterService" : "rosterOperations", ...service2 ? { service: "gsis-roster-notifier-v1" } : { identity: who }, input, timestamp: Date.now(), nonce: crypto.randomUUID(), traceId: crypto.randomUUID() }), key2 = await crypto.subtle.importKey("raw", textEncoder.encode(secret), { name: "HMAC", hash: "SHA-256" }, false, ["sign"]), signature = Array.from(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign("HMAC", key2, textEncoder.encode(raw2))), (x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
  if (guard) await guard();
  let response;
  try {
    response = await fetch(endpoint, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ payload: raw2, signature }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(["edgeExportManifest", "edgeMirror", "edgeDrift"].includes(input.operation) ? 135e3 : 55e3), redirect: "follow" });
  } catch (cause) {
    if (!["edgeExportManifest", "edgeExportCheckpoint", "edgeExportPart"].includes(input.operation)) throw cause;
    const timeout = ["TimeoutError", "AbortError"].includes(cause?.name) || /timed?\s*out|timeout/i.test(cause?.message || "");
    throw Object.assign(new Error(timeout ? "The Google bridge timed out. Its checkpoint will be checked before retry." : "The Google bridge connection failed.", { cause }), { status: timeout ? 504 : 503, code: timeout ? "ROSTER_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT" : "ROSTER_BRIDGE_NETWORK" });
  }
  let result;
  try {
    result = await response.json();
  } catch (cause) {
    if (["TimeoutError", "AbortError"].includes(cause?.name) || /timed?\s*out|timeout/i.test(cause?.message || "")) throw Object.assign(new Error("The Google bridge response timed out.", { cause }), { status: 504, code: "ROSTER_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT" });
    fail9(503, "ROSTER_BRIDGE_RESPONSE", "The Google adapter did not return a verified result.");
  }
  if (!result.ok) {
    const googleTimeout = ["edgeExportManifest", "edgeExportCheckpoint"].includes(input.operation) && /timed?\s*out|timeout|deadline|maximum execution time/i.test(String(result.code || "") + " " + String(result.error || ""));
    const error = Object.assign(Error(result.error || "The Google adapter is unavailable."), { status: googleTimeout ? 504 : result.status || 503, code: googleTimeout ? "ROSTER_GOOGLE_TIMEOUT" : ["edgeExportManifest", "edgeExportCheckpoint"].includes(input.operation) ? "ROSTER_GOOGLE_ERROR" : result.code || "ROSTER_BRIDGE_ERROR", googleCode: result.code || null });
    if (input.operation === "edgeDriveOutput") {
      error.googleCode = result.googleCode || result.code || result.status || null;
      error.outputError = outputFailure(error);
      error.message = error.outputError.message;
    }
    if (input.operation === "edgeExportManifest" && result.failureReason) error.failureReason = result.failureReason;
    throw error;
  }
  if (guard) await guard();
  return result.data;
}

  const output = {};

    if (guard) await guard();

    if (!result.ok || !Array.isArray(rows2) || rows2.length !== part.length || new Set(rows2.map((row) => row.date)).size !== part.length) fail9(503, "ROSTER_CALENDAR_REFRESH", "Calendar references could not be verified. The prior snapshot remains intact.");
    for (const row of rows2) {
      if (!part.includes(row.date) || !["odd", "even", null].includes(row.parity ?? null) || ![true, false, null, void 0].includes(row.schoolDay)) fail9(503, "ROSTER_CALENDAR_REFRESH", "Calendar references failed validation.");
      output[row.date] = { ...row, available: row.code !== "YEAR_UNAVAILABLE" && typeof row.schoolDay === "boolean" };
    }
  }
  return output;
}
async function replaceReferenceState(env, next, actor) {
  const loaded = await open(env, "roster-references", false), requestId = "references-" + crypto.randomUUID(), digest2 = await GSiSEdgeStore.digest(next);
  if (loaded.mode === "legacy") {
    const imported = await loaded.store.importState({ state: next, actor, requestId, digest: digest2, source: { kind: "signed-google-adapters" } });
    await loaded.store.transition({ from: "imported", to: "active", expectedRevision: imported.revision, actor, proof: { legacyWritesDisabled: true, sourceDigest: imported.sourceDigest, verifiedRecords: imported.importedRecords } });
    return;
  }
  if (loaded.mode === "imported") {
    await loaded.store.transition({ from: "imported", to: "active", expectedRevision: loaded.revision, actor, proof: { legacyWritesDisabled: true, sourceDigest: loaded.head.sourceDigest, verifiedRecords: loaded.head.importedRecords } });
    return replaceReferenceState(env, next, actor);
  }
  if (loaded.mode !== "active") fail9(503, "ROSTER_REFERENCES_PAUSED", "Reference storage is paused. Review migration status.");
  await loaded.store.commit({ before: loaded.state, after: next, expectedRevision: loaded.revision, actor, requestId, digest: digest2, result: { refreshed: true } });
}

async function freshRosterMetadata(env) {
  if (!env.GSIS_JOBS?.prepare && !edgeRosterEnabled(env)) return null;
  const source = database3(env), db = source.withSession?.("first-primary") || source;
  let result;
  try {
    result = await db.prepare("SELECT scope,mode,metadata_json FROM gsis_edge_heads WHERE scope IN ('roster','roster-register')").all();
  } catch (error) {
    if (!edgeRosterEnabled(env) && /no such table:\s*(?:main\.)?gsis_edge_heads\b/i.test(String(error?.message || ""))) return null;
    throw error;
  }
  if (result?.success === false || !Array.isArray(result?.results)) fail9(503, "ROSTER_EDGE_STORAGE", "The fresh Roster source identities could not be read.");
  let heads;
  try {
    heads = result.results.map((row) => ({ ...row, metadata: JSON.parse(row.metadata_json) }));
  } catch {
    fail9(503, "ROSTER_FRESH_START_PROOF", "The fresh Roster source identities could not be verified.");
  }
  if (edgeRosterEnabled(env) && heads.every((h) => ["legacy", "imported"].includes(h.mode) && !h.metadata?.freshStart)) fail9(503, "ROSTER_EDGE_NOT_ACTIVE", "Complete the verified Roster activation before running the Google backup.");
  if (edgeRosterEnabled(env) && (heads.length !== 2 || heads.some((h) => !["active", "paused"].includes(h.mode)))) fail9(503, "ROSTER_FRESH_START_PROOF", "The active Roster stores could not be verified.");
  if (!heads.some((h) => h.metadata?.freshStart)) return null;
  const fresh = heads.find((h) => h.scope === "roster")?.metadata?.freshStart;
  if (!fresh?.sourceDigest || !fresh.archiveId || heads.length !== 2 || new Set(heads.map((h) => h.scope)).size !== 2 || heads.some((h) => h.metadata?.freshStart?.sourceDigest !== fresh.sourceDigest || h.metadata?.freshStart?.archiveId !== fresh.archiveId)) fail9(503, "ROSTER_FRESH_START_PROOF", "The fresh Roster source identities do not agree.");
  return fresh;
}

async function releaseFreshRoster(env, input, who, fresh) {
  if (!edgeRosterEnabled(env)) fail9(409, "ROSTER_RELEASE_AUTHORITY", "D1 must own Roster before preparing a switch back.");
  validRequest(input.requestId);
  const db = database3(env), release = await GSiSRosterMirror.beginRelease(db, input.requestId);
  if (release.phase !== "released" && release.phase !== "paused" && !await rosterMirrorQuiescent(env)) {
    await GSiSRosterMirror.cancelRelease(db, input.requestId);
    return { released: false, pending: true, phase: "blocked", message: "Finish pending work before retrying switch-back." };
  }
  if (release.phase !== "released") await GSiSRosterMirror.sealRelease(db, input.requestId);
  let retained = await GSiSEdgeStore.open(db, "roster").receipt("fresh-start-release", input.requestId);
  if (!retained) {
    const [operations2, register] = await Promise.all(["roster", "roster-register"].map((scope) => GSiSEdgeStore.open(db, scope).exportState()));
    const changes = await db.prepare("SELECT scope,actor,request_id requestId,digest,revision,result_json result,created_at createdAt FROM gsis_edge_receipts WHERE scope IN ('roster','roster-register') ORDER BY created_at,scope,request_id").all();
    const report = { schema: "gsis-roster-fresh-start-reentry-v1", requestId: input.requestId, sourceDigest: fresh.sourceDigest, archiveId: fresh.archiveId, effectiveDate: fresh.effectiveDate, operations: operations2, register, changes: changes.results.map((r) => ({ ...r, result: JSON.parse(r.result) })) }, reference = await objectWrite(env, "fresh-start-reentry", input.requestId, report);
    retained = await GSiSRosterMirror.retainFreshRelease(db, input.requestId, { sourceDigest: fresh.sourceDigest, archiveId: fresh.archiveId, reentry: reference });
  }
  const reentry = retained.result.reentry;
  if (release.phase !== "released") {
    const proof = await signedBridge(env, { operation: "edgeFreshStartRelease", requestId: input.requestId, sourceDigest: fresh.sourceDigest, archiveId: fresh.archiveId, proof: { paused: true } });
    if (proof.released !== true || proof.sourceDigest !== fresh.sourceDigest || proof.archiveId !== fresh.archiveId || proof.requestId !== input.requestId) fail9(503, "ROSTER_RELEASE_ACK", "Google did not confirm the original archive release. Retry the same request.");

  }
  return { released: true, phase: "released", archiveOnly: true, reentry: { sourceDigest: fresh.sourceDigest, archiveId: fresh.archiveId, reference: reentry }, nextAction: "Download the D1 re-entry report, then set Pages ROSTER_EDGE_AUTHORITY=legacy." };
}
async function freshReentryReport(env) {
  let control;
  try {
    control = await database3(env).prepare("SELECT release_request FROM gsis_roster_mirror_control WHERE id=1").first();

async function edgeRosterMigration(env, input, who, internal = {}) {

      if (!progress.cleanupPending) continue;
      const abandoned = await bridge(env, { operation: "edgeExportAbandon", requestId: binding.requestId, sessionId: binding.sessionId, importActor: binding.actor, resetRequestId: input.requestId }, who);
      if (abandoned.adminVerified !== true || abandoned.abandoned !== true || abandoned.sessionId !== binding.sessionId || abandoned.resetRequestId !== input.requestId) fail9(409, "ROSTER_IMPORT_CLEANUP_PENDING", "Reset evidence is retained.     }

  }
  if (["freeze", "cancelFreeze"].includes(operation)) {

  }
  if (operation === "mirror") {

  }
  if (operation === "release") {

  }
  if (operation === "drift") {
    if (Object.keys(input).some((key2) => !["operation", "importRequestId", "sessionId"].includes(key2))) fail9(400, "ROSTER_DRIFT_INPUT", "The retained import selects the snapshot digest.");

    const manifest2 = progress.manifestDigest ? await store.manifest() : null;

      const pending = await inspectEdgeVenuesFence(env, "roster");
      if (!pending || pending.request_id !== input.requestId) fail9(409, "ROSTER_FENCE_REQUEST", "Select the pending occupancy request.");
      await revokeEdgeVenuesChange(env, { source: "roster", requestId: input.requestId });

    }
    const serviceProof = operation === "resume" ? await bridge(env, { operation: "edgeFenceStatus" }) : null;
