      const loaded = await migrationHead(env, scope), from = operation === "pause" ? "active" : "paused", to = operation === "pause" ? "paused" : "active";
      if (loaded.mode === to) {
        scopes.push(loaded.head);
        continue;
      }
      scopes.push(await loaded.store.transition({ from, to, expectedRevision: loaded.revision, actor: who.email, proof: operation === "pause" ? { reason: String(input.reason || "Administrator maintenance").slice(0, 300) } : { legacyWritesDisabled: true } }));
    }
    return { mode: operation === "pause" ? "paused" : "active", scopes };
  }
  if (operation === "refresh") {
    const proof = await bridge(env, { operation: "edgeReferences" }, who);
    if (proof.adminVerified !== true) fail9(403, "ROSTER_ADMIN_REQUIRED", "Admin access is required.");
    return refreshEdgeRosterReferences(env, { force: true });
  }
  if (operation === "freshStart") return prepareFreshRoster(env, input, who, adminProof);
  if (operation === "import") {
    validRequest(input.requestId);
    if (Object.keys(input).some((key2) => !["operation", "requestId", "sessionId"].includes(key2))) fail9(400, "ROSTER_IMPORT_INPUT", "The server selects the next import part.");
    const heads = await migrationHeads(env);
    if (heads.some((head) => ["active", "paused"].includes(head.mode))) fail9(409, "ROSTER_IMPORT_STATE", "An active or paused authority cannot prepare another import.");
    const binding = { actor: who.email, requestId: input.requestId, sessionId: sha256Hex(JSON.stringify([who.email, input.requestId])) };
    if (input.sessionId !== void 0 && input.sessionId !== binding.sessionId) fail9(409, "ROSTER_IMPORT_ID", "The session belongs to another request or actor.");
    try {
      await GSiSRosterImport.archiveRetained(database3(env), env.ROSTER_TIMETABLE_SNAPSHOTS, { maxSteps: 2, budgetMs: 2500 });
    } catch {
      console.warn(JSON.stringify({ code: "ROSTER_IMPORT_ARCHIVE_PENDING" }));
    }
    const store = GSiSRosterImport.open(database3(env), binding);
    let progress = await store.reserve();
    if (progress.requiresRestart) return progress;
    if (internal.enqueue) return { ...progress, serverDriven: true, serverImport: await queueRosterImport(database3(env), binding, who) };
    if (progress.next === "prepare") {
      const claim = await store.claimPreparation();
      let frozen = claim.result;
      const step = { ordinal: claim.ordinal, checkpoint: claim.checkpoint };
      async function recover() {
        const found = await bridge(env, { operation: "edgeExportCheckpoint", requestId: binding.requestId, sessionId: binding.sessionId, preparation: step }, who);
        if (found.adminVerified !== true || found.sessionId !== binding.sessionId) fail9(503, "ROSTER_EXPORT_INVALID", "The checkpoint session was not verified.");
        if (found.completed !== true) return false;
        const expected = sha256Hex(JSON.stringify({ sessionId: binding.sessionId, ...step }));
        if (found.checkpointInputDigest !== expected || found.preparation?.ordinal !== claim.ordinal + 1) fail9(409, "ROSTER_EXPORT_INVALID", "The completed checkpoint does not match the expected step digest.");
        frozen = found;
        await store.adoptPreparation(claim, frozen);
        return true;
      }
      __name(recover, "recover");
      if (!claim.finished) {
        let recovered = false;
        if (!claim.owned || claim.result?.failureReason) recovered = await recover();
        if (!recovered && claim.owned) {
          const started = Date.now();
          try {
            frozen = await bridge(env, { operation: "edgeExportManifest", requestId: binding.requestId, sessionId: binding.sessionId, preparation: step }, who);
            if (frozen.adminVerified !== true || frozen.sessionId !== binding.sessionId) fail9(503, "ROSTER_EXPORT_INVALID", "The immutable export session was not verified.");
            await store.commitPreparation(claim, frozen);
          } catch (error) {
            if (["ROSTER_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT", "ROSTER_GOOGLE_TIMEOUT", "ROSTER_BRIDGE_NETWORK", "ROSTER_BRIDGE_RESPONSE", "ROSTER_GOOGLE_ERROR"].includes(error.code)) {
              try {
                recovered = await recover();
              } catch (recoveryError) {
                if (recoveryError.code === "ROSTER_EXPORT_INVALID") throw recoveryError;
              }
            }
            if (!recovered) {
              const detail = error.failureReason || {}, size = claim.result?.nextStep || {}, status = ["ROSTER_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT", "ROSTER_GOOGLE_TIMEOUT"].includes(error.code) ? 504 : Number.isSafeInteger(detail.status) ? detail.status : error.status;
              const reason = { status: status >= 400 && status <= 599 ? status : 503, code: /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,79}$/.test(detail.code || "") ? detail.code : error.code || "ROSTER_GOOGLE_ERROR", ordinal: claim.ordinal, bytes: detail.bytes ?? size.bytes ?? null, records: detail.records ?? size.records ?? null, message: String(detail.message || error.message || "The preparation response was not confirmed.").slice(0, 800), phase: String(detail.phase || size.phase || claim.result?.lastPhase || (claim.ordinal === 0 ? "capture" : "preparation")).replace(/[\u0000-\u001f]/g, " ").slice(0, 80), elapsed: Number.isSafeInteger(detail.elapsed) && detail.elapsed >= 0 ? detail.elapsed : Math.max(0, Date.now() - started), ...detail.partId || size.partId ? { partId: detail.partId || size.partId } : {} };
              await store.recordPreparationFailure(claim, reason);
              throw Object.assign(new Error(reason.message + " Phase: " + reason.phase + "; " + Math.floor(reason.elapsed / 1e3) + " s; " + (reason.bytes ?? "unknown") + " bytes; " + (reason.records ?? "unknown") + " records.", { cause: error }), { status: reason.status, code: reason.code, failureReason: reason });
            }
          }
        } else if (!recovered) return { ...await store.progress(), preparing: true, preparationLeaseUntil: claim.leaseUntil, sourceDigest: claim.result?.sourceDigest || null, retryAfterMs: 2e3 };
      }
      if (!frozen || frozen.adminVerified !== true || frozen.sessionId !== binding.sessionId) fail9(503, "ROSTER_EXPORT_INVALID", "The accepted immutable preparation is unavailable.");
      if (frozen.preparing) return { ...await store.progress(), preparing: true, sourceDigest: frozen.sourceDigest || null, retryAfterMs: Math.min(5e3, Math.max(1e3, Number(frozen.retryAfterMs) || 2e3)) };
      const current = await bridge(env, { operation: "edgeReferences" }, who);
      if (current.adminVerified !== true) fail9(403, "ROSTER_ADMIN_REQUIRED", "Admin access is required to bind the prepared source.");
      if (frozen.preparationFailed) return store.failPreparation();
      await store.bind(frozen.manifest, frozen.manifestDigest);
      return { ...await store.progress(), scopes: heads };
    }
    if (progress.nextPart) {
      const parts = internal.parallelParts ? await store.pendingParts(4) : [progress.nextPart], preparation = await acceptedImportPreparation(store);
      const staged = await Promise.allSettled(parts.map(async (part) => {
        const exported = await bridge(env, { operation: "edgeExportPart", requestId: binding.requestId, sessionId: binding.sessionId, partId: part.id, ...preparation }, who);
        if (exported.adminVerified !== true || exported.sessionId !== binding.sessionId || exported.manifestDigest !== progress.manifestDigest || exported.partId !== part.id) fail9(503, "ROSTER_EXPORT_INVALID", "The immutable export part belongs to another session.");
        const verified = await store.validatePart(part.id, exported.payload), prior = await store.partReceipt(part.id);
        if (internal.guard) await internal.guard();
        const objectReceipt = part.kind === "records" || prior ? void 0 : await GSiSRosterImport.stageObject(bucket(env), store, binding.sessionId, verified.part, verified.body);
        const current = await bridge(env, { operation: "edgeReferences" }, who);
        if (current.adminVerified !== true) fail9(403, "ROSTER_ADMIN_REQUIRED", "Admin access is required to commit import progress.");
        await store.stage(part.id, exported.payload, objectReceipt);
      }));
      const failed = staged.find((result) => result.status === "rejected");
      if (failed) throw failed.reason;
      return store.progress();
    }
    if (!progress.referencesReady) {
      await refreshEdgeRosterReferences(env, { force: true, guard: internal.guard });
      const current = await bridge(env, { operation: "edgeReferences" }, who);
      if (current.adminVerified !== true) fail9(403, "ROSTER_ADMIN_REQUIRED", "Admin access is required to commit import progress.");
      return store.referencesReady();
    }
    progress = await store.finalize();
    return { ...progress, scopes: await migrationHeads(env), next: "Verify the immutable export manifest, part receipts and source digest before activation." };
  }
  if (operation === "restart") {
    validRequest(input.requestId);
    const heads = await migrationHeads(env);
    if (heads.some((head) => ["active", "paused"].includes(head.mode))) fail9(409, "ROSTER_RESTART_ACTIVE", "An active or paused authority cannot be reset.");
    const store = await migrationRetainedImport(env, input, who);
    if (!store) fail9(409, "ROSTER_IMPORT_SESSION", "No retained chunked session is available. Preserve any historical single-shot import evidence before a separate reset.");
    await store.assertRestartable(input.requestId);
    const prior = await store.progress(), reset = await store.restart(input.requestId);
    let cleanup;
    try {
      const abandoned = await bridge(env, { operation: "edgeExportAbandon", requestId: prior.requestId, sessionId: prior.sessionId, resetRequestId: input.requestId }, who);
      if (abandoned.adminVerified !== true || abandoned.abandoned !== true || abandoned.sessionId !== prior.sessionId || abandoned.resetRequestId !== input.requestId) throw Error("Abandonment was not confirmed.");
      cleanup = await store.recordRestartCleanup(input.requestId);
    } catch (error) {
      throw Object.assign(Error("D1 import reservations are reset. Restart cleanup is not yet confirmed. Retry the same restart request: " + input.requestId + "."), { status: error.status === 403 ? 403 : 409, code: "ROSTER_IMPORT_CLEANUP_PENDING", sessionId: prior.sessionId, importRequestId: prior.requestId, requestId: input.requestId });
    }
    return { ...reset, ...cleanup };
  }
  if (operation === "activate") {
    const sourceDigest = input.sourceDigest;
    if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(sourceDigest || "")) fail9(400, "ROSTER_MIGRATION_DIGEST", "Use the verified legacy export digest.");
    for (const scope of ["roster", "roster-register"]) {
      const loaded = await migrationHead(env, scope);
      if (!["imported", "active"].includes(loaded.mode) || loaded.head.metadata?.source?.sourceDigest !== sourceDigest) fail9(409, "ROSTER_IMPORT_SOURCE_MISMATCH", "Both imported scopes must match the exact legacy source digest before disabling any legacy writer.");
    }
    const restored = (await migrationHeads(env)).every((h) => h.metadata?.backupRestore?.sourceDigest === sourceDigest && h.metadata.backupRestore.verified === true);
    const proof = await bridge(env, { operation: restored ? "edgeFenceStatus" : "edgeFence", ...restored ? {} : { sourceDigest } }, restored ? void 0 : who);
    if (!restored && proof.adminVerified !== true || proof.legacyWritesDisabled !== true || !restored && proof.sourceDigest !== sourceDigest) fail9(503, "ROSTER_FENCE_UNVERIFIED", "Legacy writers were not verifiably fenced. D1 remains inactive.");
    const states = [];
    for (const scope of ["roster-register", "roster"]) {
      const loaded = await migrationHead(env, scope);
      if (loaded.mode === "active") {
        states.push(loaded.head);
        continue;
      }
      if (loaded.mode !== "imported") fail9(409, "ROSTER_MIGRATION_STATE", "Import and verify every Roster scope before activation.");
      states.push(await loaded.store.transition({ from: "imported", to: "active", expectedRevision: loaded.revision, actor: who.email, proof: { legacyWritesDisabled: true, sourceDigest: loaded.head.sourceDigest, verifiedRecords: loaded.head.importedRecords, legacySourceDigest: sourceDigest } }));
    }
    let cutoverFreeze;
    if (proof.cutoverFreeze?.active) {
      const held = await readRosterCutoverFreeze(env), done = await bridge(env, { operation: "edgeCutoverComplete", freezeId: proof.cutoverFreeze.requestId, sourceDigest });
      cutoverFreeze = await syncRosterCutoverFreeze(env, done.cutoverFreeze, { expectedRevision: held.revision });
    } else if (proof.cutoverFreeze?.state === "activated") {
      const held = await readRosterCutoverFreeze(env);
      if (held.requestId === proof.cutoverFreeze.requestId) cutoverFreeze = await syncRosterCutoverFreeze(env, proof.cutoverFreeze, { expectedRevision: held.revision });
    }
    return { active: true, legacyWritesDisabled: true, scopes: states, ...cutoverFreeze ? { cutoverFreeze } : {} };
  }
  fail9(400, "ROSTER_MIGRATION_OPERATION", "Choose status, import, restart, refresh, activate, pause, resume, recoverVenuesFence or export.");
}
async function recordEdgeAllocationFailure(env, date, id3, requestId, error) {
  try {
    await mutateEdgeRoster(env, { actor: "roster-service", requestId, command: { operation: "allocatorResult", id: id3 }, needsContext: false, apply(state, ctx) {
      const run = state.edgeAllocatorRuns?.[date];
      if (run?.id === id3 && run.state === "running") {
        Object.assign(run, { state: "failed", canCancel: false, updatedAt: ctx.iso, ...Number.isFinite(error.preparationMs) ? { preparationMs: error.preparationMs, preparationAttempts: error.preparationAttempts } : {} });
        if (Number.isFinite(run.preparationMs)) run.log.push({ seq: run.log.length + 1, at: ctx.iso, message: "Preparation took " + (run.preparationMs / 1e3).toFixed(1) + " s before failure." });
        run.log.push({ seq: run.log.length + 1, at: ctx.iso, message: error.code === "PLANNING_CLOCK_CHANGED" ? error.message : "No allocation draft was saved. Review current records before retrying." });
      }
      return { allocatorRun: run || null };
    } });
  } catch {
  }
}
async function allocateWithRun(env, p, who) {
  validRequest(p.requestId);
  const allocationMode = GSISRosterOperations.allocationMode(p), date = GSISRoster2.date(p.date || edgeRosterClock().today), id3 = sha256Hex(JSON.stringify([date, who.email, p.requestId]));
  await mutateEdgeRoster(env, { actor: who.email, who, requestId: "run-" + p.requestId, command: { operation: "currentDuty", date, runId: id3, ...p.allocationMode !== void 0 ? { allocationMode } : {} }, domainChanged: false, apply(state, ctx) {
    if (!ctx.user.smc && !ctx.user.admin) fail9(403, "ROSTER_SMC_REQUIRED", "SMC or Admin access is required.");
    state.edgeAllocatorRuns ||= {};
    const old = state.edgeAllocatorRuns[date];
    if (old && old.id !== id3 && ["running", "committing"].includes(old.state) && Date.parse(old.updatedAt) > ctx.now - 6e5) fail9(409, "ALLOCATION_IN_PROGRESS", "An allocator is already running for this date. Follow its log or cancel it.");
    const run = { id: id3, date, state: "running", authority: "d1", trigger: "manual", allocationMode, requestId: p.requestId, actor: who.email, actorName: ctx.people.find((person) => person.id === ctx.user.staffId)?.name || who.email, startedAt: ctx.iso, updatedAt: ctx.iso, canCancel: true, log: [{ seq: 1, at: ctx.iso, message: allocationMode === "fill-only" ? "Preparing to fill unassigned periods; existing assignments stay in place." : "Preparing to reoptimise blanks and unpublished automatic assignments." }] };
    state.edgeAllocatorRuns[date] = run;
    return { allocatorRun: run };
  } });
  let current = (await loadEdgeRoster(env)).state.edgeAllocatorRuns?.[date];
  if (current?.id === id3 && current.state === "failed") {
    await mutateEdgeRoster(env, { actor: who.email, who, requestId: "run-retry-" + p.requestId + "-" + (current.retryCount || 0), command: { operation: "currentDuty", date, retryRun: id3, attempt: current.retryCount || 0 }, domainChanged: false, apply(state, ctx) {
      const run = state.edgeAllocatorRuns?.[date];
      if (run?.id === id3 && run.state === "failed") {
        Object.assign(run, { state: "running", canCancel: true, retryCount: (run.retryCount || 0) + 1, updatedAt: ctx.iso });
        run.log.push({ seq: run.log.length + 1, at: ctx.iso, message: "Retrying against current records; no duplicate allocation will be created." });
      }
      return { allocatorRun: run || null };
    } });
    current = (await loadEdgeRoster(env)).state.edgeAllocatorRuns?.[date];
  }
  try {
    return await operations(env, p, who, id3);
  } catch (error) {
    await recordEdgeAllocationFailure(env, date, id3, "run-failed-" + p.requestId + "-" + (current?.retryCount || 0), error);
    throw error;
  }
}

async function resolveDuplicateIntake(env) {
  const rows2 = await dueAbsenceOverlapRecords(env);
  let resolved = 0;
  for (const original of rows2) {
    try {
      const command = JSON.parse(original.command), identity2 = JSON.parse(original.identity);
      if (command.id) {
        await deferAbsenceOverlapRecord(env, original);
        continue;
      }
      await mutateEdgeRoster(env, { actor: identity2.email, who: identity2, requestId: "intake-duplicate-" + sha256Hex(original.namespace + ":" + original.actor + ":" + original.request_id).slice(0, 48), command: { operation: "resolveDuplicateIntake", intakeRequestId: original.request_id, digest: original.digest }, contextInput: /* @__PURE__ */ __name(() => command, "contextInput"), async apply(state, ctx) {
        const row = await readAbsenceTransportRecord(env, identity2, { requestId: original.request_id });
        if (!row || row.state !== "needsReview" || row.digest !== original.digest || row.attempts !== original.attempts) fail9(409, "ROSTER_INTAKE_REVIEW_CHANGED", "The received report changed.");
        if ((state.edgeAbsenceReceipts || []).some((receipt) => receipt.id === row.request_id)) fail9(409, "ROSTER_INTAKE_ALREADY_APPLIED", "Attendance already has a receipt; retry its original transport.");
        ctx.attendanceOnly = true;
        ctx.intakeDeduplicate = true;
        ctx.reportedAt = row.accepted_at;
        const input = { ...command, revision: state.revision };
        for (const key2 of ["intake", "ownArrangementsByStaffDate"]) delete input[key2];
        const changed = GSISRosterOperations.apply(state, ctx, input);
        if (!changed.alreadyRecorded) fail9(409, "ROSTER_INTAKE_NOT_DUPLICATE", "The report needs SMC review.");
        retainEdgeAttendance(state, ctx, command, identity2, changed);
        ctx.absenceTransportResolution = { namespace: row.namespace, actor: row.actor, requestId: row.request_id, digest: row.digest, attempts: row.attempts, nextState: "forwarded", code: "ALREADY_RECORDED", reason: "Exact duplicate attendance already recorded." };
        return { alreadyRecorded: true };
      } });
      resolved++;
    } catch (error) {
      if (![400, 403, 404, 409, 422].includes(error.status)) throw error;
      await deferAbsenceOverlapRecord(env, original);
    }
  }
  return { checked: rows2.length, resolved };
}
function retainEdgeAttendance(state, ctx, p, who, changed) {
  state.edgeAbsenceReceipts ||= [];
  state.edgeAbsenceReceipts.push({ id: p.requestId, actor: who.email, date: p.date || ctx.today, command: p, savedIds: changed.savedIds, createdAt: ctx.iso, alreadyRecorded: changed.alreadyRecorded === true });
  const instructionDraft = !!p.id && (p.instructionsByStaffDate !== void 0 || p.instructionsByDate !== void 0) || hasInstructionDraft(p.instructionsByStaffDate) || hasInstructionDraft(p.instructionsByDate), peerDraft = p.ownArrangementsByStaffDate;
  if (instructionDraft) changed.instructionState = "applied";
  if (peerDraft && Object.keys(peerDraft).length) {
    state.edgePeerProposals ||= [];
    const valid = validPeerDraft(peerDraft, changed.savedIds, state);
    state.edgePeerProposals.push({ id: p.requestId, actor: who.email, identity: { email: who.email, subject: who.subject }, date: p.date || ctx.today, command: p, savedIds: changed.savedIds, status: valid ? "pending" : "needsReview", createdAt: ctx.iso, ...!valid ? { reasonCode: "PEER_INPUT_INVALID", message: "The absence is saved. Review the selected colleague arrangement before retrying." } : {} });
    changed.peerState = valid ? "pending" : "needsReview";
  }
}

async function resolveEdgeIntake(env, p, who) {
  validRequest(p.requestId);
  if (p.confirm !== true || typeof p.overlapToken !== "string" || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(p.overlapToken)) fail9(400, "ROSTER_INTAKE_CONFIRM", "Review the current overlaps and confirm your choice.");
  const loaded = await loadEdgeRoster(env, { hydrate: false }), auth = await buildEdgeRosterContext(env, loaded.state, { operation: "currentDuty" }, who);

  const result = await mutateEdgeRoster(env, { actor: who.email, who, requestId: p.requestId, command: p, contextInput: /* @__PURE__ */ __name(() => p.resolution === "merge" ? { ...command, _edgeAttendance: false } : { operation: "currentDuty" }, "contextInput"), async apply(state, ctx) {

async function queueDriveOutputAlert(env, health) {
  if (health.resolved === true) return mutateEdgeRoster(env, { actor: "roster-service", requestId: "backup-alert-recovered-" + health.alertId, command: { operation: "currentDuty" }, needsContext: false, domainChanged: false, apply(state) {
    const key2 = "drive-backup:" + health.alertId;
    for (const row of state.smcAlerts || []) if (row.key === key2 && row.audience === "system-admin" && ["open", "no-admin-recipient"].includes(row.status)) {
      row.status = "resolved";
      row.resolvedAt = new Date(Date.now()).toISOString();
    }
    return { resolved: true };
  } });
  if (!health.warnings.length) return { queued: false };
  if (GSISRosterAllocation.schedule(Date.now()).quiet || env.WHATSAPP_ENABLED !== "true") return { queued: false };
  const daily = health.kind === "daily", config = daily ? await readDailyConfig(database3(env)) : await readBackupConfig(database3(env));
  if (!config.enabled) return { queued: false };
  const message = health.message + ". Open System Health and the backup ledger.";
  try {
    return await mutateEdgeRoster(env, { actor: "roster-service", requestId: "backup-alert-" + health.alertId, command: { operation: "currentDuty" }, domainChanged: false, apply(state, ctx) {
      if ((daily ? state.systemConfig?.driveDaily?.enabled : state.systemConfig?.driveBackup?.enabled) !== true) return { queued: false };
      const key2 = "drive-backup:" + health.alertId;
      GSISRosterOperations.systemAlert(state, ctx, ctx.today, key2, message, health.kind);
      if (!state.outbox.some((j) => j.key?.startsWith(key2 + ":"))) throw Object.assign(Error("Backup alert is awaiting a recipient."), { code: "BACKUP_ALERT_PENDING" });
      return { queued: true, alertRecorded: true };
    } });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code === "BACKUP_ALERT_PENDING") return { queued: false };
    throw error;
  }
}

function gsisApiSecret4(env) {
  const value = env?.GSIS_SECRET;
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !/^[!-~]{32,8000}$/.test(value)) {
    throw Object.assign(
      Error("GSIS_SECRET must contain 32 to 8000 printable ASCII characters without spaces."),
      { status: 503, code: "GSIS_SECRET_INVALID" }
    );
  }
  return value;
}
async function timetableHash(value) {
  return [...new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", typeof value === "string" ? enc2.encode(value) : value))].map((x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}

async function runRecoveryTimetableCleanup(env, { now = Date.now(), dryRun = false } = {}) {
  const stats = { dryRun, scanned: 0, retired: 0, deleted: 0, protected: 0, failed: 0, wouldDelete: 0 };
  if (!ready(env) || !env.ROSTER_TIMETABLE_SNAPSHOTS.list || !env.ROSTER_TIMETABLE_SNAPSHOTS.head || !env.ROSTER_TIMETABLE_SNAPSHOTS.delete) return { ...stats, skipped: true, reason: "cache-disabled-or-unbound" };

  }
  try {
    const corrupt = await db.prepare("SELECT 1 FROM gsis_recovery_timetable_heads WHERE (current_json IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN json_valid(current_json) THEN json_type(current_json,'$.parts') IS NOT 'object' ELSE 1 END) OR (previous_json IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN json_valid(previous_json) THEN json_type(previous_json,'$.parts') IS NOT 'object' ELSE 1 END) LIMIT 1").first();
    if (corrupt) throw Error("Unverified cache references");

    if (expiryRows[0]?.total_bytes > 8388608) return { ...stats, skipped: true, reason: "reference-byte-bound-exceeded" };
    const expired = expiryRows.filter((h) => h.scope);
    for (const h of expired) {
      await manifest(h.current_json, h.current_hash);
      await manifest(h.previous_json, h.previous_hash);
    }
    if (!dryRun && expired.length) check(await db.batch(expired.map((h) => db.prepare("UPDATE gsis_recovery_timetable_heads SET current_json=CASE WHEN json_extract(current_json,'$.header.from')<?     stats.retired = expired.length;
    const liveHeads = check(await db.prepare("WITH limits AS (SELECT COUNT(*) head_count,COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(length(CAST(current_json AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(previous_json AS BLOB)),0)),0) byte_count FROM gsis_recovery_timetable_heads WHERE current_json IS NOT NULL OR previous_json IS NOT NULL) SELECT limits.head_count,limits.byte_count,h.current_json,h.current_hash,h.previous_json,h.previous_hash FROM limits LEFT JOIN gsis_recovery_timetable_heads h ON limits.head_count<=512 AND limits.byte_count<=8388608 AND (h.current_json IS NOT NULL OR h.previous_json IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 513").all()).results || [];
    if (liveHeads[0]?.head_count > 512) return { ...stats, skipped: true, reason: "reference-bound-exceeded" };
    if (liveHeads[0]?.byte_count > 8388608) return { ...stats, skipped: true, reason: "reference-byte-bound-exceeded" };

      await manifest(h.previous_json, h.previous_hash);

    for (const o of page.objects) {
      if (!validPath(o.key)) continue;
      if (liveKeys.has(o.key)) {
        stats.protected++;
        if (!dryRun) scanWrites.push(db.prepare("DELETE FROM gsis_recovery_timetable_candidates WHERE object_key=?").bind(o.key));
        continue;
      }
      if (!(o.uploaded instanceof Date) || o.uploaded.getTime() > now - DAY) continue;

    }
    if (scanWrites.length) check(await db.batch(scanWrites));
    const pending = check(await db.prepare("SELECT object_key,1 retired FROM gsis_recovery_timetable_tombstones WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY marked_at LIMIT 10").all()).results || [], candidates = pending.length === 10 ? [] : check(await db.prepare("SELECT object_key,uploaded_at,object_version,0 retired FROM gsis_recovery_timetable_candidates c WHERE first_seen<=? AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_recovery_timetable_tombstones t WHERE t.object_key=c.object_key) ORDER BY first_seen LIMIT ?").bind(now - DAY, 10 - pending.length).all()).results || [];
    for (const candidate of [...pending, ...candidates]) {
      const key2 = candidate.object_key;
      if (!validPath(key2)) throw Error("Cache candidate outside prefix");
      try {
        const live = await db.prepare("SELECT " + references + " protected").bind(key2, key2).first();
        if (live.protected) {
          stats.protected++;
          continue;
        }
        const stored2 = await bucket2.head(key2);
        if (stored2 && (!candidate.retired && (stored2.uploaded?.getTime() !== candidate.uploaded_at || String(stored2.version || "") !== candidate.object_version) || stored2.uploaded?.getTime() > now - DAY)) continue;
        if (dryRun) {
          stats.wouldDelete++;
          continue;
        }
        const mark = check(await db.prepare("INSERT INTO gsis_recovery_timetable_tombstones(object_key,marked_at) SELECT ?,? WHERE (?=1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_recovery_timetable_candidates WHERE object_key=? AND first_seen<=? AND uploaded_at=? AND object_version=?)) AND NOT (" + references + ") AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_recovery_timetable_cleanup WHERE id=1 AND lease_token=? AND lease_until>?) ON CONFLICT(object_key) DO UPDATE SET deleted_at=NULL WHERE NOT (" + references + ") AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gsis_recovery_timetable_cleanup WHERE id=1 AND lease_token=? AND lease_until>?)").bind(key2, now, candidate.retired, key2, now - DAY, candidate.uploaded_at ?? 0, candidate.object_version ?? "", key2, key2, token, Date.now(), key2, key2, token, Date.now()).run());
        if (mark.meta?.changes !== 1) {
          stats.protected++;
          continue;
        }
        await bucket2.delete(key2);
        check(await db.batch([db.prepare("UPDATE gsis_recovery_timetable_tombstones SET deleted_at=? WHERE object_key=?").bind(now, key2), db.prepare("DELETE FROM gsis_recovery_timetable_candidates WHERE object_key=?").bind(key2)]));
        stats.deleted++;
      } catch {
        stats.failed++;
      }
    }
    if (!dryRun) {
      const result = check(await db.prepare("UPDATE gsis_recovery_timetable_cleanup SET cursor=?,completed_day=?,lease_token='',lease_until=0,stats_json=? WHERE id=1 AND lease_token=?").bind(page.truncated ? page.cursor : "", today, JSON.stringify(stats), token).run());
      done = result.meta?.changes === 1;
    }
    return stats;
  } finally {
    if (claimed && !done) await db.prepare("UPDATE gsis_recovery_timetable_cleanup SET lease_token='',lease_until=0 WHERE id=1 AND lease_token=?").bind(token).run();
  }
}

function rosterDeliveryReviewRefresh_(state, input, recipients, now) {

      }

  if (row?.mode !== "active") fail12(503, "Roster migration is not active. Complete the verified cutover before accepting changes.");

async function dispatchEdgePeerMail(env, sendMail) {
  const summary = { sent: 0, uncertain: 0, reviewedUncertain: 0, newUncertain: 0, blocked: 0, cancelled: 0, pending: 0 }, origin = String(env.ROSTER_PUBLIC_ORIGIN || "").replace(/\/$/, "");
  if (!/^https:\/\/[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9])?(?::\d{1,5})?$/i.test(origin)) return { ...summary, blocked: 1, reason: "Configure ROSTER_PUBLIC_ORIGIN." };
  const readiness = await edgeDispatchProbe(env, "peerMail");
  if (readiness.has_work === 0) return summary;
  for (let count = 0; count < 6; count++) {
    const claim = await service(env, { operation: "claimPeerMail" }, (state, ctx) => {
      GSiSEdgeNotifications.peerMailSync(state, state, ctx.people, ctx.now, peerMailToken);
      const row = state.peerMail.find((r) => r.status === "queued");
      if (!row) return { job: null, newUncertain: GSiSEdgeNotifications.peerMailHealth(state.peerMail, peerMailToken), counts: GSiSEdgeNotifications.peerMailCounts(state.peerMail, peerMailToken), pending: state.peerMail.filter((r) => ["queued", "blocked", "sending"].includes(r.status)).length };
      const request = state.requests.find((r) => r.id === row.requestId);
      row.status = "sending";
      row.preparedAt = ctx.now;
      row.claimId = crypto.randomUUID();
      row.claimExpiresAt = ctx.now + 6e5;
      row.attempts++;
      row.error = "";
      return { job: clone3(row), mail: GSiSEdgeNotifications.peerMailMessage(request, origin, row.email) };
    });
    if (!claim.job) return { ...summary, ...claim.counts, newUncertain: summary.newUncertain + claim.newUncertain, pending: claim.pending };
    const job = claim.job;
    const prepared = await service(env, { operation: "preparePeerMail", id: job.id, claimId: job.claimId }, (state, ctx) => {
      const row = (state.peerMail || []).find((r) => r.id === job.id && r.claimId === job.claimId);
      if (!row || row.status !== "sending" || row.launchAuthorizedAt) return { send: false };
      const request = state.requests.find((r) => r.id === row.requestId), person = ctx.people.find((p) => String(p.id) === String(row.recipientId));
      if (!GSiSEdgeNotifications.peerMailPending(request, ctx.now) || row.fingerprint !== GSiSEdgeNotifications.peerMailFingerprint(request) || !GSiSEdgeNotifications.peerMailAddresses(person).includes(row.email)) {
        row.status = "cancelled";
        row.error = "The proposal or authorised recipient changed before submission.";
        return { send: false };
      }
      row.launchAuthorizedAt = ctx.now;
      return { send: true };
    });
    if (!prepared.send) {
      summary.cancelled++;
      continue;
    }
    let status = "uncertain", error = "Email acceptance was not confirmed. Check with the recipient before sending again.";
    try {
      const result = await sendMail({ operation: "sendEdgeMail", id: job.id, claimId: job.claimId, mail: claim.mail });
      if (result.ok && result.data?.accepted === true) {
        status = "sent";
        error = "";
      } else if (result.ok && result.data?.notSent === true) {
        status = "blocked";
        error = "Email service is unavailable; no message was sent.";
      }
    } catch {
    }
    const settled = await service(env, { operation: "settlePeerMail" }, (state, ctx) => {
      const row = (state.peerMail || []).find((r) => r.id === job.id && r.claimId === job.claimId);
      if (!row) fail12(409, "Peer email claim changed.");
      if (row.status !== "sent" && ["sending", "uncertain"].includes(row.status)) {
        row.status = status;
        row.error = error;
        row.completedAt = ctx.iso;
        if (status === "blocked") delete row.launchAuthorizedAt;
        if (status === "sent") row.acceptedAt = ctx.iso;
        GSiSEdgeNotifications.peerMailAlert(state, row, state, ctx.now, peerMailToken);
      }
      return { recorded: true, newUncertain: GSiSEdgeNotifications.peerMailHealth(state.peerMail, peerMailToken) };
    }, false);
    summary[status]++;
    summary.newUncertain += settled.newUncertain;
  }
  return { ...summary, pending: 1 };
}

async function dispatchEdgeEmploymentMail(env, sendMail) {
  const outcome2 = { sent: 0, failed: 0, uncertain: 0, blocked: 0, cancelled: 0 }, origin = String(env.ROSTER_PUBLIC_ORIGIN || "").replace(/\/$/, "");

        row.status = "cancelled";

        row.completedAt = ctx.iso;

      }

        row.status = "uncertain";
        row.error = "Email acceptance was not confirmed. Check the mailbox before sending again.";

      }

      if (!job) return { job: null, cancelled, uncertain };

      if (!snapshot) {
        job.status = "failed";
        job.error = "The original report snapshot is unavailable.";
        job.completedAt = ctx.iso;
        return { failed: true, cancelled, uncertain };
      }
      if (!addresses.has(job.to)) {
        job.status = "blocked";
        job.error = "The selected email is no longer in Contacts.";
        return { blocked: true, cancelled, uncertain };
      }

        job.completedAt = ctx.iso;
        return { failed: true, cancelled, uncertain };

      job.status = "sending";
      job.claimId = crypto.randomUUID();
      job.claimedAt = ctx.iso;
      return { job: clone3(job), cancelled, uncertain, mail: { to: job.to, subject: job.subject, ...content, name: "GSiS Roster" } };
    });

    outcome2.uncertain += claim.uncertain || 0;
    if (claim.failed) {
      outcome2.failed++;
      continue;
    }
    if (claim.blocked) {
      outcome2.blocked++;
      continue;
    }
    if (claim.skip) continue;
    if (!claim.job) return outcome2;
    let status = "uncertain", error = "Email acceptance was not confirmed. Check the mailbox before sending again.", notSent = false;
    try {
      const result = await sendMail({ operation: "sendEdgeMail", id: claim.job.id, claimId: claim.job.claimId, mail: claim.mail });

        status = "sent";
        error = "";
      } else if (result.ok && result.data?.notSent === true) {
        status = "queued";
        notSent = true;
        error = "Email service is unavailable; no message was sent.";
      }
    } catch {
    }
    await service(env, { operation: "settleEmploymentMail" }, (state, ctx) => {
      const row = state.dailyEmploymentMail.find((row2) => row2.id === claim.job.id && row2.claimId === claim.job.claimId);

      }

  }
  return outcome2;

function gsisResponseAdvice(error, layout = false) {
  if (error.code === "UPSTREAM_SCHEMA") return "Layout received an incompatible data response. Ask an Admin to check the installed Deploy backend version.";
  if (error.code === "BACKEND_CONFIG") return "The backend connection URL is not configured correctly.";
  if (error.code !== "UPSTREAM_RESPONSE") return "";
  switch (error.responseInfo?.kind) {
    case "access":
      return "Google blocked the backend request. Ask an Admin to check the Apps Script web app access settings.";
    case "execution":
      return "Apps Script returned an execution error. " + (layout ? "Ask an Admin to run diagnoseLayout601 in the Deploy script and read its execution log." : "Ask an Admin to check the backend execution log.");
    case "deployment":
      return "The Apps Script deployment could not be opened. Ask an Admin to check the existing web app URL.";
    default:
      return "Apps Script returned an unreadable response. " + (layout ? "Ask an Admin to check the deployed backend and run diagnoseLayout601 in the Deploy script." : "Ask an Admin to check the deployed backend and its access settings.");
  }
}

function capabilityFields(claims, now) {
  if (!claims || !["duties", "mutual"].includes(claims.purpose) || typeof claims.staffId !== "string" || !claims.staffId || claims.staffId.length > 200 || !validDate(claims.date) || !Number.isFinite(claims.expiresAt) || !Number.isFinite(claims.issuedAt) || claims.issuedAt < 0 || claims.issuedAt > now + 6e4 || claims.expiresAt <= claims.issuedAt || claims.expiresAt - claims.issuedAt > LINK_AGE) throw privateLinkError("PRIVATE_LINK_INVALID");
  if (claims.purpose === "mutual" && (typeof claims.requestId !== "string" || !claims.requestId || claims.requestId.length > 200)) throw privateLinkError("PRIVATE_LINK_INVALID");
  if (claims.communicationId !== void 0 && (claims.purpose !== "duties" || typeof claims.communicationId !== "string" || !claims.communicationId || claims.communicationId.length > 200)) throw privateLinkError("PRIVATE_LINK_INVALID");
  if (claims.expiresAt <= now) throw privateLinkError("PRIVATE_LINK_EXPIRED");
  return { staffId: claims.staffId, date: claims.date, purpose: claims.purpose, ...claims.communicationId ? { communicationId: claims.communicationId } : {}, ...claims.purpose === "mutual" ? { requestId: claims.requestId } : {}, issuedAt: claims.issuedAt, expiresAt: claims.expiresAt };
}

async function createCapability(claims, env, now = Date.now()) {
  if (!configuredSecret(env.EXTERNAL_LINK_SECRET)) throw privateLinkError("PRIVATE_LINK_CONFIGURATION");

    aud = publicOrigin(env);
  } catch {
    throw privateLinkError("PRIVATE_LINK_CONFIGURATION");
  }
  const issuedAt = Number.isFinite(claims?.issuedAt) ? claims.issuedAt : now;
  const expiresAt = claims?.purpose === "duties" ? issuedAt + LINK_AGE : Math.min(claims?.expiresAt, issuedAt + LINK_AGE);
  const data = { ...capabilityFields({ ...claims, issuedAt, expiresAt }, now), aud, type: "gsis-roster-link-v2", nonce: crypto.randomUUID() };

}

async function readCapability(token, env, origin, now = Date.now()) {

async function serviceBackend(env, input) {
  assertRecoveryWritable(env);
  const delegated = await callOperationalBackend(env, "roster-service", { input });
  if (delegated !== void 0) return delegated;
  if (edgeRosterEnabled(env)) {
    try {
      if (input.operation === "sendPeerMail") return { ok: true, data: await dispatchEdgePeerMail(env, (mail) => legacyServiceBackend(env, mail)) };
      if (input.operation === "dailyEmploymentMailDispatch") return { ok: true, data: await dispatchEdgeEmploymentMail(env, (mail) => legacyServiceBackend(env, mail)) };
      if (input.operation === "deliveryReviewMailDispatch") return { ok: true, data: await dispatchEdgeDeliveryReview(env, input) };
      if (supportsEdgeNotificationOperation(input.operation)) return { ok: true, data: await edgeNotificationService(env, input) };
      return { ok: true, data: await edgeRosterService(env, input) };
    } catch (error) {
      return { ok: false, status: error.status || 503, code: error.code || "EDGE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE", error: error.status && error.status < 500 ? error.message : "The service could not be confirmed. Retry with the same request." };
    }
  }
  try {
    const result = await legacyServiceBackend(env, input);
    return result?.ok ? result : { ...result, operation: input.operation };
  } catch (error) {
    error.operation = input.operation;
    throw error;
  }
}

async function dispatchInboxPending(env) {
  if (env.WHATSAPP_ENABLED !== "true") return { enabled: false };
  if (edgeRosterEnabled(env) && !await edgeDispatchHasWork(env, "inbox")) return { enabled: true, replies: 0, alerts: 0, unconfirmed: 0 };
  const pending = await serviceBackend(env, { operation: "inboxPendingDispatch" });
  if (!pending.ok) throw rosterScheduledFailure(pending);
  const replies = pending.data?.replies || [], alerts = pending.data?.alerts || [];
  if (!Array.isArray(replies) || replies.length > 5 || !Array.isArray(alerts) || alerts.length > 5) throw Error("Invalid inbox dispatch queue.");
  const result = { enabled: true, replies: replies.length, alerts: alerts.length, unconfirmed: 0 };
  for (const reply of replies) try {
    await dispatchInboxReply(reply, env);
  } catch {
    result.unconfirmed++;
  }
  try {
    await dispatchInboxAlerts(alerts, env);
  } catch {
    result.unconfirmed++;
  }
  return result;
}

function audioMime(value) {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length > 100) return null;
  const [type, ...parameters] = value.toLowerCase().split(";").map((x) => x.trim());
  if (!["audio/aac", "audio/mp4", "audio/mpeg", "audio/amr", "audio/ogg"].includes(type) || parameters.some((p) => p !== "codecs=opus")) return null;
  return type === "audio/ogg" ? "audio/ogg; codecs=opus" : type;
}

async function boundedMedia(response, limit) {
  const size = Number(response.headers.get("Content-Length"));
  if (Number.isFinite(size) && size > limit) throw Object.assign(Error("Attachment exceeds the size limit."), { permanent: true });
  const reader = response.body?.getReader();
  if (!reader) throw Error("Attachment download is unavailable.");
  const chunks = [];
  let length = 0;
  try {
    for (; ; ) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      length += value.byteLength;
      if (length > limit) throw Object.assign(Error("Attachment exceeds the size limit."), { permanent: true });
      chunks.push(value);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    await reader.cancel().catch(() => {
    });
    throw e;
  }
  if (!length) throw Error("Attachment download was empty.");
  const bytes2 = new Uint8Array(length);
  let offset = 0;
  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    bytes2.set(chunk, offset);
    offset += chunk.byteLength;
  }
  return bytes2;
}

  if (input.operation === "acknowledge") {
    const notice = input.timetableNoticeId;
    if (notice !== void 0 && (typeof notice !== "string" || !notice.trim() || notice.length > 300 || /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(notice)) || !Array.isArray(input.snapshotIds) || !input.snapshotIds.length && !notice || input.snapshotIds.length > 100 || input.snapshotIds.some((x) => typeof x !== "string" || !x.trim() || x.length > 160)) return json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid acknowledgement." }, 400);
    serviceInput.snapshotIds = input.snapshotIds;
    if (notice !== void 0) serviceInput.timetableNoticeId = notice;
  }
  if (!edgeRosterEnabled(env) && input.operation === "view" && capability.purpose === "mutual") serviceInput.calendarByDate = { [capability.date]: await calendarDate(env, capability.date, null) };
  if (input.operation === "respond") {
    if (capability.purpose !== "mutual") return json({ ok: false, error: "This link cannot approve relief." }, 403);
    if (!["approve", "reject"].includes(input.decision) || typeof input.requestId !== "string" || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,100}$/.test(input.requestId)) return json({ ok: false, error: "Choose Approve or Reject." }, 400);
    const reason = String(input.reason || "").trim();
    if (reason.length > 1e3 || input.decision === "reject" && !reason) return json({ ok: false, error: "Give a reason for rejection (up to 1,000 characters)." }, 400);
    Object.assign(serviceInput, { decision: input.decision, reason, requestId: input.requestId });
    if (!edgeRosterEnabled(env) && input.decision === "approve") serviceInput.calendarByDate = { [capability.date]: await calendarDate(env, capability.date, null) };
  }
  try {
    const result = await serviceBackend(env, serviceInput);
    return json(result, result.ok ? 200 : result.status || 503);
  } catch {
    return json({ ok: false, error: "The request could not be confirmed. Reload this page to check its current state." }, 503);
  }
}

function notificationConfig(env, requireEnabled = true, diagnostic = null) {
  let field = "WHATSAPP_ENABLED";
  try {
    if (requireEnabled && env.WHATSAPP_ENABLED !== "true") throw Error("Notifications are disabled.");
    field = "WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID";
    if (!/^\d{5,30}$/.test(env[field] || "")) throw Error("WhatsApp setup is incomplete.");
    field = "WHATSAPP_API_VERSION";
    if (!/^v\d+\.\d+$/.test(env[field] || "")) throw Error("WhatsApp setup is incomplete.");
    for (field of ["WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN", "WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET", "GSIS_SECRET", "EXTERNAL_LINK_SECRET"]) {
      if (!configuredSecret(field === "GSIS_SECRET" ? gsisApiSecret6(env) : env[field])) throw Error("WhatsApp setup is incomplete.");
    }

async function readTemplateCatalogue(env) {
  let url = "https://graph.facebook.com/" + env.WHATSAPP_API_VERSION + "/" + env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_ACCOUNT_ID + "/message_templates?fields=name,language,status,category,parameter_format,components&limit=100";

    if (u.hostname !== "graph.facebook.com" || u.protocol !== "https:") throw Error("Invalid template pagination.");
    const response = await fetch(u, { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + env.WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(1e4), redirect: "manual" });
    if (!response.ok) throw Error("Template approval check failed. No send was attempted.");

    if (!Array.isArray(value.data)) throw Error("Invalid template approval response.");
    live.push(...value.data);
    url = value.paging?.next || null;
  }
  if (url) throw Error("Template catalogue exceeds the bounded approval check.");
  return live;
}

function templateContractMatches(record, expected) {
  if (!record || record.category !== "UTILITY" || record.name !== expected.name || record.language !== expected.language) return false;
  if (record.parameter_format && record.parameter_format !== "POSITIONAL") return false;
  const components = record.components || [], body = components.find((c) => c.type === "BODY");
  const buttons = components.find((c) => c.type === "BUTTONS");
  const expectedButtons = expected.urlButtons || expected.staticUrlButtons;
  if (components.length !== (expectedButtons?.length ? 2 : 1) || body?.text !== expected.body) return false;
  if (expectedButtons?.length && (!Array.isArray(buttons?.buttons) || buttons.buttons.length !== expectedButtons.length || buttons.buttons.some((b, i) => b.type !== "URL" || b.text !== expectedButtons[i].text || b.url !== expectedButtons[i].url))) return false;
  const nums = [...new Set([...body.text.matchAll(/{{(\d+)}}/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1])))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  return nums.length === expected.fields.length && nums.every((n, i) => n === i + 1);
}

function templateText(value, field, limit = 1024, isUrl = field.endsWith("_url")) {
  if (value === void 0 || value === null || !["string", "number"].includes(typeof value) || typeof value === "number" && !Number.isFinite(value)) throw Error("MISSING_OR_INVALID_TEMPLATE_FIELD:" + field);
  const raw2 = String(value);
  if (!raw2.trim() || /[\u0000-\u0008\u000b\u000c\u000e-\u001f\u007f-\u0084\u0086-\u009f]/.test(raw2)) throw Error("MISSING_OR_INVALID_TEMPLATE_FIELD:" + field);
  if (isUrl) {
    try {
      const u = new URL(raw2);
      if (u.protocol !== "https:" || !u.hostname || u.username || u.password || /[\s\u0085\\]/u.test(raw2) || raw2.length > 4096) throw Error();
    } catch {
      throw Error("INVALID_TEMPLATE_URL:" + field);
    }
    return raw2;
  }
  const text = raw2.split(/\r\n|[\r\n\u0085\u2028\u2029]/u).map((line) => line.replace(/[\t\p{Zs}]+/gu, " ").trim()).filter(Boolean).join("; ");
  if (!text) throw Error("MISSING_OR_INVALID_TEMPLATE_FIELD:" + field);
  if ([...raw2].length > 32e3 || [...text].length > limit) throw Error("NOTIFICATION_CONTENT_EXCEEDS_VERIFIED_TEMPLATE");
  return text;
}

          if (!recorded) {
            summary.resultFailures++;
            confirmed = false;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (!confirmed) break;
      }
    }
    if (results.some((result) => result.rateLimited)) {
      width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(width / 2));
      summary.pending = true;
      summary.reason = "provider-cooldown";
      summary.readyAt = Date.now() + Math.max(...results.map((result) => result.retryAfterMs || 0));
      break;
    }
    if (results.every((result) => result.state === "sent")) width = Math.min(maxParallel, width + 1);
  }
  if (previousResults.length) await settle(previousResults);
  summary.elapsedMs = Date.now() - started;
  if (Date.now() - started >= budget - 3e4 || summary.claimed >= 500) summary.pending = true;
  return summary;
}

async function enqueueNotificationWake(env, purpose = "gsis-notification-wake-v1") {
  if (!["gsis-notification-wake-v1", "gsis-roster-import-wake-v1", "gsis-roster-backup-wake-v1"].includes(purpose)) throw Error("Invalid wake purpose.");
  if (!env.NOTIFICATION_DISPATCH_URL) return { queued: false, mode: "scheduled" };
  const url = new URL(env.NOTIFICATION_DISPATCH_URL);
  if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password || url.search || url.hash || url.pathname !== "/dispatch") throw Error("Invalid notification dispatcher URL.");
  if (!configuredSecret(gsisApiSecret6(env))) throw Error("Notification wake secret is not configured.");
  const body = await sign({ purpose, timestamp: Date.now(), nonce: crypto.randomUUID() }, gsisApiSecret6(env));
  const response = await fetch(url, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body), redirect: "manual", signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8e3) });
  if (!response.ok) throw Error("Notification wake could not be queued. The scheduled worker will recover the durable intent.");
  return { queued: true, mode: "immediate" };
}

async function handleIncomingMessage(message, env, ctx) {
  if (env.WHATSAPP_ENABLED !== "true") return { disabled: true };
  if (typeof message.id !== "string" || !message.id.startsWith("wamid.") || !/^\d{8,15}$/.test(String(message.from || "")) || !/^\d+$/.test(String(message.timestamp || ""))) throw Error("Invalid incoming message.");
  const captured = message.type === "audio" ? await captureInboxAudio(message, env) : message.type === "image" ? env.WHATSAPP_DURABLE_INGRESS === "true" || edgeRosterEnabled(env) ? await captureInboxMedia(message, env, "image") : { image: inboxMediaMetadata(message, "image"), retry: false } : null;
  const retained = { id: message.id, from: message.from, timestamp: Number(message.timestamp), type: message.type, text: message.type === "image" ? message.image?.caption : message.type === "text" ? message.text?.body : message.type === "interactive" ? message.interactive?.list_reply?.title || message.interactive?.button_reply?.title : message.type === "button" ? message.button?.text : void 0, profileName: message.profileName, context: message.context?.id ? { id: message.context.id } : void 0, ...captured ? { [message.type]: captured[message.type] } : {} };
  const ingested = await serviceBackend(env, { operation: "inboxIngest", message: retained });
  if (!ingested.ok) throw Error("Incoming message could not be retained.");
  if (env.WHATSAPP_MENU_ENABLED !== "true" || ["audio", "image"].includes(message.type) || Number(message.timestamp) * 1e3 <= Date.now() - 864e5) {
    if (captured?.retry) throw Error("Audio capture will retry.");
    return { recorded: true };
  }
  const input = { operation: "inboundMessage", inboxMode: true, messageId: message.id, from: message.from, timestamp: Number(message.timestamp) * 1e3, type: message.type, text: message.type === "text" ? message.text?.body : void 0, selection: message.type === "interactive" ? message.interactive?.list_reply?.id || message.interactive?.button_reply?.id : void 0 };
  const saved = await serviceBackend(env, input);
  if (!saved.ok) throw Error("Incoming message could not be recorded.");
  const result = saved.data;
  if (!result?.reply) {
    if (captured?.retry) throw Error("Audio capture will retry.");
    return result;
  }
  let state = "failed", messageId = "";
  try {
    const payload = menuReply(result.reply, env);
    state = "uncertain";
    const response = await sendWhatsAppPayload(payload, env), value = await response.json();
    if (response.ok && typeof value.messages?.[0]?.id === "string") {
      state = "sent";
      messageId = value.messages[0].id;
    } else if (!response.ok && response.status < 500 && value.error) state = "failed";
  } catch {
  }
  const recorded = await serviceBackend(env, { operation: "inboundReplyResult", receiptId: result.receiptId, replyClaimId: result.replyClaimId, state, messageId });
  if (!recorded.ok) throw Error("Reply outcome unconfirmed.");
  if (captured?.retry) throw Error("Audio capture will retry.");
  return { ...result, reply: void 0, replyState: state };
}

async function acceptWebhookJobs(env, statuses, incoming) {
  if (!env.GSIS_JOBS?.batch) throw Error("Durable webhook storage is not configured.");
  const now = Date.now(), jobs = [];
  for (const status of statuses) {
    const eventId = await sha256Hex2(enc3.encode(JSON.stringify([env.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, status.messageId, status.state, status.timestamp, status.recipientId])));
    jobs.push({ id: "status:" + eventId, kind: "status", payload: JSON.stringify({ ...status, eventId }) });
  }
  for (const message of incoming) {
    if (typeof message.id !== "string" || !/^wamid\.[\w=.+/-]{1,500}$/.test(message.id) || !/^\d{8,15}$/.test(String(message.from || "")) || !/^\d+$/.test(String(message.timestamp || ""))) throw Error("Invalid incoming message.");
    jobs.push({ id: "incoming:" + await sha256Hex2(enc3.encode(JSON.stringify([env.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, message.id]))), kind: "incoming", payload: JSON.stringify(message) });
  }
  if (jobs.length) {
    const results = await env.GSIS_JOBS.batch(jobs.map((job) => env.GSIS_JOBS.prepare("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO gsis_webhook_jobs (id,phone_id,account_id,kind,payload,created_at,available_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").bind(job.id, String(env.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID), String(env.WHATSAPP_ACCOUNT_ID), job.kind, job.payload, now, now)));
    if (results.some((result) => result.success === false)) throw Error("Webhook acceptance was not committed.");
  }
  return jobs.length;
}

      if (result.success === false) throw Error("Webhook claim failed.");
      return result.results || [];
    }, "claim");
    let rows2 = await claim("status", bounded);
    if (!rows2.length) rows2 = await claim("incoming", Math.min(2, bounded));
    if (!rows2.length) break;

      const delay = Math.min(36e5, 15e3 * 2 ** Math.min(8, Math.max(0, row.attempts - 1)));

AND state='claimed' AND claim_id=?").bind(Date.now() + delay, row.id, claimId);
      const saved = await statement.run();
      if (saved.success === false) throw Error("Webhook settlement failed.");
      if (success) summary.completed++;
      else summary.retrying++;

    const statuses = rows2.filter((row) => row.kind === "status");
    if (statuses.length) {
      let success = false;

        success = true;
      } catch {
      }
      for (const row of statuses) await finish(row, success);

    for (let offset = 0; offset < incoming.length; offset += 2) await Promise.all(incoming.slice(offset, offset + 2).map(async (row) => {

      } catch {
      }
      await finish(row, success);
    }));
  }
  await env.GSIS_JOBS.prepare("DELETE FROM gsis_webhook_jobs WHERE state='done' AND completed_at<?").bind(Date.now() - 30 * 864e5).run();
  return { ...summary, elapsedMs: Date.now() - started };
}

async function whatsappWebhook(req, env, ctx) {
  const u = new URL(req.url);
  if (req.method === "GET") {
    if (!configuredSecret(env.WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN) || u.searchParams.get("hub.mode") !== "subscribe" || u.searchParams.get("hub.verify_token") !== env.WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN) return json({ ok: false, error: "Verification failed." }, 403);
    const challenge = u.searchParams.get("hub.challenge") || "";
    if (!/^\d{1,100}$/.test(challenge)) return json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid challenge." }, 400);
    return new Response(challenge, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain", "Cache-Control": "no-store", "Referrer-Policy": "no-referrer" } });
  }
  if (req.method !== "POST") return json({ ok: false, error: "POST required." }, 405);
  if (!configuredSecret(env.WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET) || !env.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID || !env.WHATSAPP_ACCOUNT_ID) return json({ ok: false, error: "Webhook is not configured." }, 503);
  const bytes2 = new Uint8Array(await req.arrayBuffer());
  if (bytes2.length > 262144) return json({ ok: false, error: "Request too large." }, 413);
  const signature = req.headers.get("X-Hub-Signature-256") || "";
  if (!signature.startsWith("sha256=") || !await verifyHmac(bytes2, signature.slice(7), env.WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET)) return json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid signature." }, 401);
  let event;
  try {
    event = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes2));
    if (event.object !== "whatsapp_business_account" || !Array.isArray(event.entry)) throw Error();
  } catch {
    return json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid event." }, 400);
  }
  const statuses = [], incoming = [];
  for (const entry of event.entry) {
    if (String(entry.id) !== String(env.WHATSAPP_ACCOUNT_ID)) continue;
    for (const change of entry.changes || []) {
      if (change.field !== "messages" || String(change.value?.metadata?.phone_number_id) !== String(env.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID)) continue;
      for (const message of change.value?.messages || []) incoming.push({ ...message, profileName: (change.value?.contacts || []).find((c) => String(c.wa_id) === String(message.from))?.profile?.name });
      for (const status of change.value?.statuses || []) {
        if (!["sent", "delivered", "read", "failed"].includes(status.status) || typeof status.id !== "string" || !status.id.startsWith("wamid.") || !/^\d+$/.test(String(status.timestamp || ""))) continue;
        statuses.push({ messageId: status.id, state: status.status, timestamp: Number(status.timestamp) * 1e3, recipientId: String(status.recipient_id || ""), notificationId: typeof status.biz_opaque_callback_data === "string" ? status.biz_opaque_callback_data : "", ...status.errors?.[0] ? { error: inboxProviderError(status.errors[0], "WhatsApp confirmed that delivery failed."), providerError: providerDiagnostic(status.errors[0]) } : {} });
      }
    }
  }
  if (statuses.length > 100 || incoming.length > 20) return json({ ok: false, error: "Too many status events." }, 413);
  try {
    if (env.WHATSAPP_DURABLE_INGRESS === "true" || edgeRosterEnabled(env)) {
      const accepted = await acceptWebhookJobs(env, statuses, incoming);
      if (accepted && ctx?.waitUntil) ctx.waitUntil(dispatchWebhookJobs(env, { budgetMs: 1e4, limit: 4 }).catch(() => console.error(JSON.stringify({ event: "roster-webhook-drain-retry" }))));
      return json({ ok: true, accepted });
    }
    await webhookStatusEvents(statuses, env);
    for (const message of incoming) await handleIncomingMessage(message, env, ctx);
    if (incoming.length && env.WHATSAPP_MENU_ENABLED === "true") await enqueueNotificationWake(env);
    return json({ ok: true });
  } catch {
    return json({ ok: false, error: "Delivery status could not be recorded." }, 503);
  }
}

function settleMessages(batch, messages, action, options) {
  if (messages.every((message) => typeof message[action] === "function")) {
    for (const message of messages) message[action](options);
    return;
  }
  if (messages.length === batch.messages.length) batch[action + "All"](options);
  else if (action === "retry") batch.retryAll(options);
}
__name(settleMessages, "settleMessages");
async function catchUpAllocationAudit(env) {
  const startedAt = Date.now();
  let summary = { exported: 0, failed: 0 };
  for (let step = 0; step < 3 && Date.now() - startedAt < 2e4; step++) {
    if ((await quietMode(env.GSIS_JOBS)).active) return { ...summary, skipped: true };
    if (Date.now() - startedAt >= 2e4) break;
    const result = await dispatchAllocationAudit(env);
    summary = { ...result, exported: summary.exported + result.exported, failed: summary.failed + result.failed };
    if (result.skipped || result.failed || result.pending === 0 || result.exported === 0) break;
  }
  return summary;
}
